text.body:
oṃ namaḥ śivādibhyo gurubhyaḥ |
yastṛdhā triṣvavasthā surūpamāsthāya śaktimān | udbhavasthitisaṃhārakṛtsnaṃ viśvasya śaktitaḥ ||
vidadhāti namastasmai śuddhāmṛtamayātmane | śivāya brahmaviṣṇveśa parāya paramātmane ||
kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaraṃ | krīḍaṃtaṃ ca gaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ pārvatyā sahitaṃ haraṃ ||
dṛṣṭvā pramuditaṃ daivaṃ prāṇināṃ hitakāmyayā | utsaṃgādavatīryāśu pādau jagrāha pārvatī ||
papraccha parayā bhaktyā santoṣya parameśvaraṃ |
śrīdevyuvāca ||
bhagavaṃ devadeveśa lokanātha jagatpate | yaṃ tvayā mahadāścaryaṃ kṛtaṃ vismayakārakaṃ ||
sarvasya jagato deva kiṃtu me parameśvara | durvijñeyaṃ durārādhyaṃ rahasyaṃ na prakāśitaṃ ||
kārtike yasya na mayā na sureṣu gaṇeṣu ca | yogeśvarīṇāṃ mātrīṇāṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ yogināṃ na hi ||
tadadya me jagannātha suprasanno yadi prabho |
<1b>
prārthayāmi prapannāhaṃ niḥśeṣaṃ vaktumarhasi ||
evaṃ devyā vacaḥ śrutvā prasannavadano vravīn |
bhagavānuvāca ||
kiṃ kiṃ vadasi suśroṇi rahasyānte hṛdi sthitaṃ ||
sarvaṃ vakṣyāmyasaṃdehi toṣito 'haṃ tvayā naghe |
devyuvāca ||
bhagavaṃ devadeveśa citrāścarya vidhāyakaṃ | āścaryamīdṛśaṃ ramyaṃ na śrutaṃ tacchṛṇomyahaṃ ||
vibho prasannavadana paramānaṃdakāraka | amātsaryeṇa bhagavan kathanīyaṃ tvayā mama ||
yat tadāpomayaṃ deva cakṣuḥ sarvatra dṛśyate | tasmādagniḥ kathaṃ raudra utpannaḥ kāladāhakaḥ ||
yena vai dṛṣṭamātreṇa pitrīṣā bhasmasāt kṛtaḥ | kiṃ tadraudraṃ kṛtaṃ deva vahniḥ kāladidṛkṣayā ||
prajvālita jagatsarvaṃ brahmādicchā varāntikaṃ | kāmastathaiva nirdagdho līlayā parameśvara ||
krodhanetrānale nātha dṛśyate yanna kasyacit |
<2a>
kṛtaṃ tad devadevena mahāvismayakārakaṃ ||
devanetrāṃtare hyagnistvadṛte kasya dṛśyate | kiṃ vā vahnimayaṃ cakṣustatkathaṃ na vibhāvyate ||
yena vai cakṣuṣā kṛtsnaṃ prasarastvaṃ jagatpate | sarvāmṛtamayenaiva jagadāpyāyakṛt kṣaṇāt ||
mamānaṃdayase deva prasannenaiva cakṣuṣā | amṛtākārasaṃśubhraṃ jagadāpyāyakārakaṃ ||
tasmāt kālānalaprakhyaṃ kuto vahniḥ prajāyate | etat sarvaṃ samāsena bhagavan vaktumarhasi ||
bhagavānuvāca ||
atikautūhalāviṣṭā pṛcchasyetacchṛṇu priye | yanme netrāṃtare hyagni yadvāmṛtamanuttamaṃ ||
tatsarvaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yogayuktyā śṛṇu priye | yatsvarūpaṃ nijaṃ śuddhaṃ vyāpakaṃ sarvatomukhaṃ ||
sarvabhūtāntarāvasthaṃ sarvaprāṇiṣu jīvanaṃ | yogagamyaṃ durārādhyaṃ duṣprāpaṃmakṛtātmabhiḥ ||
svasaṃvedyaṃ svavīryaṃ ca mamaiva paramaṃ padaṃ | tadvīryaṃ sarvavīryāṇāṃ tadvai balavatāṃ balaṃ ||
<2b>
tadojastejasāṃ sarvaṃ śāśvataṃ hyacalaṃ bruvaṃ | sāmamecchā parāśaktirhyaviyuktā svabhāvajā ||
vahni ūṣme ca vijñeyā ravirūpā raveriva | sarvasya jagato vāpi sā śaktiḥ kāraṇātmikā ||
sarvajñādi guṇāstatra vyaktāvyaktāśca saṃsthitā | saivecchā jñānarūpā ca jñānādi guṇavismṛtāḥ ||
jñānādi ṣaṭguṇā ye ca tatrasthāḥ prabhavanti ca | sā vai kriyā mahārūpā saṃsthitaikā kriyā matā ||
aṇimādi guṇānaṣṭau karoti vikaroti sā | evaṃ mamecchā jñānājñā kṛyākhyā śaktirucyate ||
sūryācaṃdramasau vahnistridhāmaparikalpanā | trinetrakalpanāmahyaṃ tadarthamiha dṛśyate ||
dahanāpyāyanantena prakāśya vidadhāmyahaṃ | sṛṣṭisthitiṃ saṃhṛtiṃ ca tanurvidhāmyahaṃ ||
tadvīryā pūritaṃ sarvaṃ matteja upabṛhitaṃ | icchājñānakriyārūpaṃ netrāmṛtamanuttamaṃ ||
tadvīryaṃ paramaṃ dhāma yat parāmṛtarūpakaṃ |
<3a>
sa eṣa paramānaṃdo dehe tat paramaṃ padaṃ | tadetanniṣkalaṃ jñānaṃ viśuddhaṃ netramuttamaṃ ||
mṛtyujit tena cākhyātaṃ sarveṣā mokṣadāyakaṃ | tat siddhidaṃ paraṃ devi sarvaduḥkhavimokṣadaṃ ||
sarvavyādhi haraṃ devaṃ sarvāharamayaṃ śivaṃ | dāridrya damanaṃ nityaṃ mṛtyujit sarvato mukhaṃ ||
amoghamamalaṃ śāntaṃ sarvagaṃ sarvasaṃsthitaṃ | sūryakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ vahnyāyutasahasraśaḥ ||
yat tejasā samastasya kalānārghaṃnti ṣoḍaśī | sarvantejomayaṃ tasmādapradhṛṣyaṃ surāsuraiḥ ||
tena netrāgninā sarvaṃ nirdahāni kṣaṇāddhruvaṃ | tenaivāpyāyanaṃ bhūyaḥ prākāśya vidadhāmyahaṃ ||
tasmāt parataraṃ nānyat kiṃ vidvīrya pradṛśyate | tadevāstramayaṃ raudraṃ aṇoḥ santāraṇaṃ paraṃ ||
kṣayakṛt sā śatrūṇāṃ astraṃstvetadudāhṛtaṃ | sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ āyuddhānte tadāyudhaṃ ||
tadekaṃ bahudhā vīryaṃ bhedānaṃtavisarpitaṃ | mahāpāśupataṃ mahyaṃ viṣṇostacca sudarśanaṃ ||
<3b>
brahmaṇo brahmadaṃḍaśca sarveṣāṃ svasvamāyudha | anekākārarūpeṇa āyudhaṃ tadanekadhā ||
surāṇāṃ susvarūpeṇa mayāvīryaṃ samarpitaṃ | jñānaśaktyā tu yogeśyā tena vyāptamidaṃ jagat ||
bhītānāṃ sā parā rakṣātra snānāṃ abhayaṃ paraṃ | śatrubhiścārditānāṃ tu mokṣadaṃ paramaṃ dhruvaṃ ||
kiṃ vā vistaraṇoktena paunapuṇyena suṃdari | yadyannivrataraṃ raudraṃ śrīmadvarjitameva vā ||
prasādaṃ varadaṃ śreyaḥ prakāśyantattadeva hi | tad jñeyamaprameyaṃ ca jñānaṃ mantraṃ mahābalaṃ ||
trātāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ guptagopyaṃ sadā mayā | tavādya kathitaṃ devi bhūyaḥ paripṛcchasi ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛttiśavidhāne [taṃtrāvatārādhikāro nāma prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 1 || śrīdevyuvāca ||
yadyevaṃ paramaṃ śāntaṃ aprameyaṃ guṇālayaṃ | sarvānugrahakaṃ vīryaṃ devadeva mukhācchrutaṃ ||
<4a>
bhagavaṃ devadeveśa lokānugrahakāraka | triyonijamidaṃ sarvaṃ devamānuṣa tiryagaṃ ||
ādhivyādhi bhayo dvignaṃ viṣabhūtabhayārditaṃ | apamṛtyu śatāṃ karṇaṃ jvarakāsakṣayānvitaṃ ||
bhūtajaṃ mānuṣe loke viprādyāḥ prāṇinastathā | duḥkhadoṣaśatākīrṇaṃ kutaṃsteṣāṃ sukhaṃ vibho ||
yugānurūpabhāvena teṣāmāyuṃ svamānataḥ | jighāṃsanti balopetāstvattejabalabṛṃhitāḥ ||
anekaśatabhedaistu vyādhādi vinipīḍitāḥ | teṣāmanugrahārthāya kṛpayā prāṇināṃ hitaṃ ||
upāyastu jagannāthamucyante yena sarvataḥ | yena yena prakāreṇa jñānayogena maṃtrataḥ ||
yat tat paśyati deveśa tamupāyaṃ vadasva me | evaṃ devyā vacaḥ śrutvā prahasyo vāraśaṃkaraḥ ||
īśvara uvāca ||
atikāruṇyayā viṣṭā devitvaṃ pṛcchase mama | na kena vidahaṃ pṛṣṭho nākhyātaṃ kasya cinmayā ||
yat tat sarveṣu netreṣu netrabhūtaṃ(?) prakīrtitaṃ |
<4b>
mamāṃśakena kenāpi lakṣitaṃ tu sudurlabhaiḥ | tavādya kathayiṣyāmi tṛprakāraṃ paraṃ dhruvaṃ ||
maṃtrayogajñānagamyaṃ mokṣadaṃ siddhidaṃ paraṃ | ādau maṃtramayaṃ vakṣye siddhatrayasamanvitaṃ ||
sāṃgaṃ svamudrayā yuktaṃ sarvatrāṇakaraṃ paraṃ | bhūtayakṣagrahonmāda śākinī yoginī gaṇaiḥ ||
bhaginī rudramātrībhi ḍāvyāḍāmarakādibhiḥ | rūpikābhirapasmāraiḥ piśācaiścāpyanekaśaiḥ ||
brahmarakṣograhādibhyaḥ koṭiśo yadi mudritāḥ | apamṛtyubhirākrāntāḥ kālapāśajighāṃsatā ||
rājāno rājatanayā rājapatnyo hyanekaśaḥ | viprādi prāṇinaḥ sarve sarvadoṣa bhayārditāḥ ||
yena vai smṛtamātreṇa mucyate tad bravīmite | bhūya pradeśe same ramye caṃdanāguru carcite ||
karpūrāmodagaṃdhāḍhye kuṃkumodaka carcite | ācārya suprahṛṣṭātmā caṃdanāguru carcitaḥ ||
uṣṇīrādyairābharaṇairbhūṣitaḥ sumahāmatiḥ |
<5a>
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā mātrikāṃ tatra cālikhet | tritanuṃ madhyato lekhyaṃ vargāṣṭau prāgviṣo likhet ||
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā puṣpadhūpārghavistaraiḥ | maṃtramātā tato devi proddharet maṃtramuttamaṃ ||
viśvādyaṃ viśvarūpānta viśvahāmṛtakaṃ dalaṃ | sveti dhvani parāśaktiḥ śivamekatra yojayet ||
anena grathitaṃ sarvaṃ sūtremaṇi gaṇā iva | asmātmaṃtrāsamutpannā saptakoṭyādhikāriṇaḥ ||
citrabhānu padāntasthaṃ śaśāṃkaśakalodaraṃ | tadaṃkuśordhvavinyastaṃ tiryagaṃ tūrdhvayojitaṃ ||
etat tat paramaṃ jyotiretat tat paramāmṛtaṃ | etat paramamuddiṣṭaṃ amṛtaṃ lokaviśrutaṃ ||
peyūṣa kalayā yuktaṃ pūrṇacaṃdranibhopamaṃ | etat paratamaṃ dhāma etat paratamaṃ padaṃ ||
etat paratamaṃ vīryaṃ etat paramāmṛtaṃ | tejasāṃ paramaṃ tejaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ ||
sarvasya jagato deva īśvaraṃ kāraṇaṃ dhruvaṃ | sraṣṭā kartā ca hartā ca nāstyasya jagato valī ||
<5b>
maṃtrāṇāmālayaṃ hyeṣa sarvasiddhiguṇāspadaḥ | adhunāṃgāni vakṣyāmi sannaddhoyaistu sidhyati ||
kṛtāntamadhyamaṃ varṇaṃ surarā (*?) ca mānugaṃ | prabhaṃjanānta śirasaṃ hṛadayā sarvasaṃsthitaṃ ||
sāmāntamanalādyena yuktaṃ praṇavayojitaṃ | śiro hyeṣo nilāntena yukto māyā śikhā smṛtā ||
praśāntamīśvarordhvaṃ ca dvādaśārddhaniyojitaṃ | śivaśaktistathā nādayuktaṃ tadvatmanottamaṃ ||
sabhairavādyaṃ praṇavaṃ sadāgati śira sthitāṃ | netramaṃtra mahodagraṃ sarvakilviṣa nāśanaṃ ||
ajīvakaṭasaṃyuktaṃ astrametat prakīrtitaṃ | aṃgaṣaṭka samākhyāta maṃtrarājasya nisṛtaṃ ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre amṛtīśavidhāne mṛtyuṃjaye [maṃtroddhāravidhirdvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] || īśvara uvāca ||
adhunā yajanaṃ vakṣye yena siddhyanti maṃtrarāṭ | ādau snāna prakurvīta sarvakilviṣanāśanaṃ ||
<6a>
astramaṃtreṇa deveśi mṛdamuddhṛtya maṃtravit | śaucaṃ yathoditaṃ kṛtvā snānaṃ paścāt samācaret ||
pādau jaṃghe kaṭī caiva pūvadbhiḥ tribhistṛbhiḥ | tribhiraṃtarayogena saptabhiḥ śuddhyate manaḥ ||
saptābhimaṃtritaṃ kṛtvā mṛdamastreṇa maṃtravit | pratāṃpyārka mukhe paścāccharīramanulepayet ||
vighnopaśamanārthaṃ tu kṣālyamaṃtarjalaṃ japet | vāmahaste tato bhāgān mṛdayātrīṃstu kārayet ||
astrajaptaṃ kṣiped dikṣu mūle tīrthaṃ prakalpayet | aṃgaiḥ śarīramālipya kṣālyamantarjalaṃ japet ||
mūlaṃ śaktyā samuttīrya saṃdhyāṃ vaṃdedanukramāt | śikhāṃbaddhvā śikhāsmṛtvā maṃtrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tataḥ ||
devān pitṝnṛṣīṃścaiva manujān bhūtasaṃyutān | santarpatīrthaṃ saṃgṛhya yāgoktavidhinā viśet ||
āśāmātrī gaṇaṃ lakṣmī naṃdigaṃge prapūjayet | mahākālaṃ tu yamunāṃ dehalīṃ pūjayet tataḥ ||
<6b>
vighna proccāṭanaṃ kṛtvā digbaṃdhaṃ kavacāstrayoḥ | svāsanārthaṃ prakalpyeta śaktimādhārapūrvikāṃ ||
upaviśya tataḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmamanukramāt | dhāraṇāmārabhet tatra yugapacchoṣaṇādibhiḥ ||
ṣāṅkoṣikaṃ(?) tu malinaṃ digbaṃdhaṃ tatra bhāvayet | vijñānaṃ kevalantatra śūnyantatragataṃ smaret ||
nāhamasti na cānyosti dhyeyaṃ cātra nivedyate | ānaṃdapadasallīnaṃ manaḥ samarasī gataṃ ||
paścādādhāraśaktisthaṃ sthā(?)sanaṃ paribhāvayet | dhātrīpayogivaṃ padmāṃ caṃdrabiṃvāvabhāsitaṃ ||
paścāt kalākalāpotthaṃ peyūṣena tu siṃcitaṃ | mūrti pūrvaṃ tṛtatve tu mūle naiva prakalpayet ||
tatoṃgāni karābhyāṃ tu śarīre vinyaset punaḥ | maṃtraṃ caivābhimānaṃ tu cintaye dhyānayogataḥ ||
dhenumudrā tato baddhvā padmamudrā tathāpi vā | dhyāyedātmani deveśaṃ caṃdrakoṭisamaprabhaṃ ||
svacchamuktā phalaprakhyaṃ sphaṭikāhni samaprabhaṃ |
<7a>
kuṃdeṃdu gokṣire nibhaṃ hi mādṛśaṃ vibhuṃ | śubhrādvāreṃdu kāṃtādi sitabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ ||
sitacaṃdanaliptāṃgaṃ karpūrakṣodadhūsaraṃ | sphuracaṃdrāmṛtasphāra bahulormipariplutaṃ ||
somamaṃdalamadhyasthaṃ ekavaktraṃ trilocanaṃ | sitapadmopaviṣṭaṃ ca baddhapadmāsanasthitaḥ ||
caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ vadarābhayapāṇinaṃ | pūrṇacaṃdranibhaṃ śubhraṃ mṛtenaiva pūritaṃ ||
kalaśaṃ dhārayantaṃ hi jagadāpyāya kārakaṃ | paripūrṇaṃ tathā caṃdraṃ vāmahaste vicintayet ||
sarvaśvetopacāreṇa pūjitaṃ tamanusmaret | bahunātra kimuktena sākṣādamṛtasāgaraṃ ||
tasmādeva samutpannamamṛtaṃ viśvajīvanaṃ | atha cintāmaṇi prakhyaṃ bhāvabhedena saṃsmaret ||
saumyaṃ raudraṃ tathā bhīmaṃ vikṛtaṃ bhāvabhedataḥ | sadāśivaṃ bhairavaṃ ra(?)ntaṃ cuṃruṃ vīranāyakaṃ ||
yena yena hi rūpeṇa sādhakaṃssaṃsmare tadā | tasya tanmayatāṃ yāti cintāmaṇi riveśvaraḥ ||
<7b>
evaṃ dhyātvā yajed devaṃ mānasaiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ | hṛtpadme sarvasiddhyarthaṃ paścād bāhye prapūjayet ||
mānasaiḥ kusumairarcā sādhakena śubhāmatā | anirmālya parāśuddhā mokṣadā siddhidā śubhā ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mānasaṃ yajanaṃ dhruvaṃ | ādāve prakartavyaṃ paścād dravyaistu vistaraiḥ ||
svagṛhe devatāgāre saṃgame girimūrddhani | supraśaste tu bhūbhāge padmaśaṃḍe suśobhane ||
ālikhet maṃḍalaṃ citraṃ sitarekhopaśobhitaṃ | caturdvāraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ susamaṃ tu matoramaṃ ||
śobhāpaśobhasaṃpannaṃ tanmadhye śaśimaṃḍalaṃ | pūrṇacaṃdrasamaprakhyaṃ raśmimālāvalī yutaṃ ||
tanmadhyeṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ susitaṃ caṃdrasannibhaṃ | vicitrakesaropetaṃ hemakarṇikamuttamaṃ ||
tanmadhye caiva deveśaṃ svasthānādavatārayet | āvāhayet tato devaṃ tridehaparikalpitam ||
<8a>
āgneyādi vibhāgena daleṣvaṃgāni vinyaset | pūjyaśvetopacāreṇa puṣpāṃvaravilepanaiḥ ||
naivedyairvividhaiścitrairdhūpaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ sudhūpitaiḥ | hṛdyaiḥ pānaiścarvividhairbhāvabhedena pūjayet ||
sarvaśvetopacāreṇa śāntyarthaṃ pūjayet pṛye | puṣṭyarthaṃ bahubhirmiśraiḥ saṃbhāraḥ saṃskṛtaṃ yajet ||
paścāddhomaṃ prakurvīta yathākarmānurūpataḥ | trimekhale vartule ca caturaśre suśobhane ||
hastamātre tataḥ kuṃḍe ṣaḍaṃgenorddhamekhale | madhyamādi catuṣkeṇa dvādaśāṃgena cādhamā ||
hastamātraṃ tataḥ khātaṃ oṣṭhamekāṃgulāyataṃ | aśvatthapattra sadṛśī nābhiḥ kuryānnavāṃgulā ||
dairghyāt tu pārśvatastadvatatmadhyāgrāṃgulanvayaṃ | uktaṃ sāhasrike homa dviguṇaṃ cāyute mataṃ ||
tripaṃca yuta homena triguṇaṃ tadvidhīyate | kuṃḍaṃ vai lakṣaṇopetaṃ lakṣahome praśasyate ||
nityanaimittike kāmye śāntau puṣṭau tu vartulaṃ |
<8b>
sarvadikṣu praśāmyeta śrīkāme caturaśrakaṃ | śasyate pūrvamānena yaṃ dṛṣṭvā karmabhedataḥ ||
saṃskārānvasya kuṃḍasya kartavyā astramaṃtrataḥ | adhaḥkaraṇamuddhāraṃ abhikṣepaṃ prapūraṇaṃ ||
secanaṃ kuṭṭanaṃ caiva mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā | praṇavena tu kartavyaṃ kuṃḍasya parikalpanā ||
catuṣpathaṃ cākṣavāṭaṃ vāgeśyā gṛhakalpanaṃ | asinā praṇavenaiva vāgeśyā vāhanaṃ puna ||
arvanaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ tritatvenanta prokṣaṇaṃ | astreṇa tāḍanaṃ caiva saṃskṛtyavidhipūrvakaṃ ||
kriyāśakti svarūpeṇa kauṃḍilyā kuṃḍakalpanā | jñānaśaktisvarūpaṃ tu vahnintatra prakalpayet ||
vahnimādāya pātrasthaṃ paṃcasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaṃ | nirīkṣaṇādi cāstreṇa kavacenāvaguṃṭhanaṃ ||
praṇavenāhutiḥ paṃca hutvā dravyādi śuddhitaḥ | viśvāgnyāpādanaṃ paścāt kurvīta bhrāmaye tṛdhā ||
bījarūpaṃ tato vahnimātmāne parameśvaraṃ |
<9a>
māyā caiva tu yogeśī yonau saṃkṣobhya saṃkṣipet | vartulīkṛta viśvāgnau pūjanaṃ praṇavena tu ||
kartavyaṃ tanmukhe paścāt saṃskārastu tato nale | garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayaṃ tathā ||
vaktrakalpanaviśvāgnau sīmāgrīvādi kalpana | jātakarma tathaivātra niṣkrāmonāmakalpanā ||
hṛdayādyaṃga ṣaṭkena kartavyamanupūrvaśaḥ | cūḍādyā ye tu saṃskārā pūrṇāhutyekayā punaḥ ||
saṃskārāṇi tu sarvāṇi vahnau mūlena kārayet | śivaśakti mayantatra kalpaye tu vidhānavit ||
sruksruvau tu dṛḍhau kāryau kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhavau | śasyate śāntipuṣṭau tu śastadrumasamudbhavau ||
anyatra bhāvabhedena kāryaukamānurūpataḥ | ṣaṭtṛṃśadaṃgulaṃ mānaṃ srugvāvāhu pramāṇataḥ ||
ṣaḍaṃśapariṇāhena daṃḍaḥ kuṃbhāt samutthitaḥ | caturaṃgulapīṭhāgraṃ tatpīṭhaṃ kamalodaraṃ ||
kartavyaṃ daṃḍamadhye tu dvyaṃgulāyatavartulaṃ |
<9b>
arddhāṃgulasamutsedha vicitraracanākulaṃ | vedikāṣṭāṃgulākāryā caturāsuśobhanā ||
adhaḥ padmā niviṣṭānta ūrdhvi(?) paṃcāṃgulāyuta |
khātaṃ taṃ aṃgulaṃ kāryaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ vartulabhramaṃ | arddhāṃgulapramāṇena tilakairupaśobhitaṃ ||
tasya pārśva catuṣkaṃ tu catuṣkoṇasamanvitaṃ | śilpivijñānaracanā nānā bhiracitaṃ mataṃ ||
kaṃtha ekā.uglaḥ kāryasta tribhāgavikalpitaḥ | pārśvayośca tataḥ kāryaṃ mukhaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ śubhaṃ ||
dairghyāṃ tu pārśvayoṣṭau tu dvau bhāgau hrāsayet kramāt | mukhāgraṃ tat tribhāge tu dvau bhāgau pārśvayostathā ||
vartayedvedayetāṃ tu kaniṣṭhāṃgulimānataḥ | nimnaṃ nimnataraṃ kuryād yāvaccāgramukhāntaraṃ ||
pārśvayostu tathā kāryā vicitra racanā śubhā | svatṛbhāgavivarta syāt pārśvayostu tathaiva ca ||
hastamātra sruvaḥ kāryo mūlapīṭhe triśākhikaṃ | madhyāgrapīṭhapadmāṃka kaṃṭhācāṃgulavartulaṃ ||
<10a>
caturaṃguladīrghaṃ tu dvipuṭāgraṃ suvartitaṃ | aṃguṣṭhaparvavat khātaṃ goṣpadākṛtikārayet ||
kaniṣṭhāṃgulamānena pratiṣṭhā khātu vartulā | vartayedravacanāyuktaṃ karṣāpūritavaktrakaṃ ||
catuṣpalā bhavet pūrṇā sruvāśaktiḥ sruvaḥ śiva | kriyāśaktistu vai kuṃḍaṃ jñānaśaktistathā nalaṃ ||
evaṃ niṣpādya vidhivat paścāddhomaṃ samācaret | tilaiḥkṣīrayutairhomaṃ śarkarāghṛtamiśritaiḥ ||
mahāśāntiprajāyeta tatkṣaṇāt nātrasaṃśayaḥ | ādau caivājya(?)saṃskāraṃn kuryāddhomamathāparaṃ ||
adhiśrayaṇamuddhāraṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ sthāpanaṃ tataḥ | nirīkṣaṇaṃ tatostreṇa nairājanamataḥ paraṃ ||
paryagni karaṇaṃ caiva tathaivotplavasaṃplavau | astre caivārcanaṃ mūle nāmṛtīkaraṇaṃ tathā ||
darbhāstaraṃ viṣṭarāṇi paridhī nastramaṃtrataḥ | sūryācaṃdramasauvahni kalpayet praṇavena tu ||
bhāvayet tavajihvā tu pūrṇāṃ mūlena pātayet |
<10b>
paścāttūtaṃ maṃtraṃ sāgaṃ madhyamataṃ yajet | evaṃ kṛtvā tu juhuyānmaṃtrī karmānusārataḥ ||
payasāghṛtayuktena puṣṭirbhavatiśāśvatī | ghṛtagugguluhomena pūrṇāyurbhavate dhruvaṃ ||
śrīkāmaṃ juhuyāt paścān ghṛtakṣīrasamanvitaṃ | rājyakāmostato bilvā trisaṃdhāktāt susiddhidāt ||
kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhistu homācāro gṛ(?)tāṃ bhabhet | praśastasamidhā homāt praśasta taruje nale ||
sarvakāmānavāpnoti satyameva navānyathā | brīhisaptakahomena dhanārthī labhate dhanaṃ ||
īhitaṃ kāmamuddiśya īhitaṃ homamācaret | payasā kevale naiva homānmṛtyuṃjaye dhruvaṃ ||
kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhistu homādārāmva(?)to labhet | praśasta samidhā homāt praśastena jale nalaṃ ||
sarvakāmānavāpnoti satyametaṃ na cānyathā |
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahaṃ sāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [yajanādhikāra tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
<11a>
īśvara uvāca ||
atha dīkṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktiphalapradāṃ | bhūtatanmātradaśakaṃ manobuddhirahaṃkṛtaṃ ||
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva īśvaraṃ ca sadāśivaṃ | śivamaṣṭādaśaṃ nāma tatkāryevaviśodhayet ||
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaścaiva nipatiḥ kāla eva ca | māyā vidyā tathaiśaṃ ca sadāśivaśivastathā ||
tatvāni navadhā samyak śodhayeddaiśikottamaḥ | tatvaiśaṭtṛṃśadarddhena tadarddhe nātha paṃcabhiḥ ||
tribhirekena vā kāryā parāparavibhūtaye | yā kalābhiḥ paṃcabhirvātha padairdīkṣāthavā punaḥ ||
varṇaiḥ paṃcāśato vāpi maṃtrairvā bhuvanaistathā | etaiḥ sarvaiḥ prakartavyā kāryā ekatamāthavā ||
sarvaistu samudāyena vyaktiśakti svarūpataḥ | yathā vibhavasāreṇa kartavyādaiśikottamaiḥ ||
vāgeśyāḥ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ tadgarbhe yojayet paśuṃ | garbhādhānaṃ tu jananaṃ adhikāra layaṃ tathā ||
<11b>
bhogaḥ karmārjanaṃ caiva niṣkṛtistadanantaraṃ | mūlamaṃtreṇa kartavyaṃ pāśacchaidastathā smṛtaḥ ||
astramaṃtreṇa dāhastūtaṃ bhasmīkaraṇa sthitiḥ | śikhācchedaṃ tathā homaṃ mūlenaiva tu yojayet ||
saṃyojya parame tatve saṃsthānaṃ caiva kārayet | adhikārārthamācārye parāpara pade sthitiḥ ||
śivatatve svadhākārāṃ vidyādīkṣā sadāśive | putrake parame tatve samayinyeśvare tathā ||
evamuddeśato dīkṣā kathitā vistarenyataḥ |
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [dīkṣādhikāraścaturthaḥ paṭalaḥ] || īśvara uvāca ||
abhiṣekaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā yasyaiva dīyate | aṣṭabhiḥ kalaśairdeyamācāryasya vidhānataḥ ||
te tu vidyeśvarāḥ proktā samudrāśca sagarbhagāḥ | paṃcabhirbhūtasaṃkhyairvā tribhirvā tatvarūpakaiḥ ||
ātmavidyā śivākhyaistu ekenāpi śivātmanā | adhikārārthamācārye sādhake siddhikāmataḥ ||
<12a>
abhiṣikto hyanujñātaḥ prakuryānmaṃtrasādhanaṃ | tadvratastamasācārastadbhaktastatparāyaṇaḥ ||
pavitrāhāranirato laghvāśī saṃyateṃdritaḥ | ekānte puṇyakṣetre tu tīrthāyatana gocare ||
sarvasaṃgojjhitamanāḥ sādhako japamārabhet | lakṣameka japenmaṃtrī pūrvameva samāhitaḥ ||
tena sāmānya karmāṇi siddhyante sādhakasya tu | bhaumīṃ siddhimavāpnoti daśalakṣa japena tu ||
antarikṣīṃ labhet siddhi lakṣapaṃcāśatoddhruvaṃ | divyāṃ siddhiṃ tu labhate sādhako nātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
yathā koṭi kṛterjapyai īśvarī siddhimāvahet | vyāpakastu śivo bhūtvā nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥ ||
yathecchāṃ kurute sarvāṃ dhārayet saṃharedbhṛśaṃ | sarvagassarvavettā ca sarvajño bhavate dhruvaṃ ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāna [abhiṣekasādhanādhikāraḥ paṃcamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || <12b>
śrīdevyuvāca ||
śrutaṃ mayā mahādeva mṛtyujit siddhimokṣadaṃ | adhunāśrotumicchāmi siddhi traya samanvitaṃ ||
amṛtīśaṃ mahātmānaṃ sarvaprāṇiṣu jīvanaṃ | yadā siddhi prado loke mānuṣāṇāṃ hitaṃ karaṃ ||
pūrvokta duṣṭaśamanaṃ apamṛtyuvināśanaṃ | āpyāyanaṃ śarīrasya śāntipuṣṭipradaṃ śubham ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śrūyatāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutaṃ | yathātaraṃti manujā duḥkho dadhi pariplutā ||
apamṛtyuśatākrāntā jarādāridryasaṃyutā | ādhivyādhibhayodvignā pāpaughairvinipīḍitāḥ ||
mucyante tu yathā sarve pūrvoktairmāraṇaiḥ pṛye | trividhaṃ tadupāyaṃ tu sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ ca yat ||
<13a>
sthūlaṃ ca yajanaṃ homaṃ japa dhyānaṃ samaudrakaṃ | maṃtrāṇi saṃpuṭādīni maṃtrarāṭ kurute bhṛśaṃ ||
sūkṣmaṃ cakrābhiyogena kalānādyādayena ca | paraṃ sarvātmakaṃ devaṃ mokṣadaṃ mṛtyujid bhavet ||
yadā mṛtyubhayā ghrātaṃ kālena kalitaṃ pṛye | dṛṣṭastatpratighānārthamamṛteśaṃ yajet tadā ||
sarvaśvetopacāreṇa pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ | yasya nāmaṃ samudiśya pūjayet mṛtyujid vibhuḥ ||
mṛtyoruttarate śīghraṃ satyaṃ menānṛtaṃ vacaḥ | sitaśarkara yā yukto ghṛtakṣīra plutaistilaiḥ ||
puṇyadārvidhane vahnau kuṃḍe vṛtte trimekhale | mahārakṣā vidhānena yasya nāmāṃkito hunet ||
mahāśaktirbhavet kṣipraṃ gatasyāpi yamālayaṃ |
<13b>
athavā śarkarāyuktaṃ payasā kevalena tu | homānmṛtyuṃjaye cchīghraṃ mṛtyuṃjinnātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
sugaṃdhaghṛtahomena kṣīravṛkṣamaye nale | juhuyānnāśayenmṛtyuṃ mṛtyujinnātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
kṣīravṛkṣasamiddho vā jvaraṃ nāśayate kṣaṇāt | tilataṃḍulamakṣīka ājyaṃkṣīrasamanvitaṃ ||
eṣa paṃcāmṛto homa sarvaduṣṭa nivāraṇaṃ | guggulāṃgulikābhiśca tryaktāśca śakramātrayā ||
homātpuṣṭirbhavatyāśu kṣīṇadehasya suvrate | yadā vyādhiśā kīrṇā hyabalo dṛśyate naraḥ ||
tadā tu saṃpuṭī kṛtya nāmajaptvā vimucyate | yaṃ yaṃ maṃtraṃ japed vidvānamṛtīśena saṃpuṭaṃ ||
sa tasya siddhyate kṣipraṃ bhāgyahīnopi yo bhavet | kṣīṇagātrasya deveśi bheṣajaṃ maṃtrasaṃpuṭaṃ ||
dīyate tatkṣaṇā devi sapuṣṭiṃ labhate balī |
<14a>
hṛtpadmamadhyagaṃ jīvaṃccaṃdrasaṃpuṭamadhyagaṃ | sādhyarṇaroṣitaṃ kṛtvā mṛtyuruntarate bhṛśaṃ ||
sādhyarṇa rodhitaṃ nityaṃ dhyāyed dehaṃ sa yogavit | sarvavyādhivinirmukto sabhavennātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
kṣīrodamadhyapadmasthaṃ amṛtormibhirākulaṃ | ūrddhvādhaḥ śaktiruddhaṃ tu sādhyarṇasaṃpuṭīkṛtaṃ ||
yo dhyāyati sadṛṣṭātmā hyātmanasya parasya vā | sabāhyābhyantaraṃ śubhraṃ svadhāpūritavigrahaṇaṃ ||
amudvignamanāyaśca sarvabhogaiḥ pramucyate | rocanā kuṃkumenaiva kṣīreṇa ca samanvitaṃ ||
sitapadmeṣṭa patre tu madhyasādhyaṃ nirodhitaḥ | sarvavyādhi parākrāntaṃ caṃdramaṃḍalaveṣṭitaṃ ||
catuṣkoṇe parākrānto vajrabhṛdvajrarodhitaḥ | mucyate nātrasaṃdeho sarvavyādhi prapīḍitaḥ ||
ṣoḍaśāre mahāpadme ṣoḍaśasvarabhūṣite | ādyantamaṃtrarodhena sādhyanāmaṃ vilekhayet ||
jīvāntaṃ sāvamadhyasthaṃ varṇāṃtāṃtena rakṣitaṃ |
<14b>
pratyarṇamamṛtīśena saṃpuṭi tvānusarvataḥ | madhye daleṣu sarveṣu śaśimaṃḍalamadhyagaṃ ||
bāhye tu dviguṇaṃ padmaṃ kādisāntaṃ krameṇa tu | pūrvavat tu likhenmaṃtrī pratisādhyarṇa rodhitaṃ ||
varṇe tadanu sādhyasya nāmabāhyerkamaṃḍalaṃ | puraṃdara pure paścāt samantāt parivārayet ||
śvetacaṃdanayuktāyāṃ rocanākṣīrayuktayā | likhitvā maṃtravājānāṃ karpūrakṣodadhūsaraṃ ||
mahārakṣāvidhānaṃ tu sukhasaubhāgyadāyakaṃ | etaccakra mahādevi sitapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ||
sarvaśvetopacāreṇa madhumadhye nidhāpayet | anenaiva vidhānena saptāhān mṛtyujid bhavet ||
rājarakṣāvidhānaṃ tu bhūbhṛtāmaprakāśayet | saṃgrāmakāle varadaṃ ṛpudarpāpahaṃ bhavet ||
śivādinavatatvāni pratyekaṃ śaśimaṃḍale | madhye pūrvādimīśāntaṃ amṛtīśena maṃtravit ||
yadā vyādhi śatākrāntā apamṛtyubhireva ca |
<15a>
tadā śvetopacāreṇa pūjyaṃ kṣīraghṛtena ca ||
tilaiḥ kṣīrasamidbhirvā homācchāntiṃ samaśnute | evasaṃpūjya kuṃbhe tu sarvauṣadhi samanvitaḥ ||
sitagarbhamaye śubhre rannagarbhāṃbupūrite | sarvamaṃgalaghoṣeṇa śirasi hyabhiṣecayet ||
samucyatena saṃdeho sarvavyādhi prapīḍitaḥ | dhyātvā parāmṛtaṃ nityaṃ nityoditamanāmayaṃ ||
prakṛdyāntassamamṛtaṃ avatārya parāśivān | caturṇavāmṛtādhāra navadhāna ca pūritaṃ ||
śatārddhakṣobhitā nityaṃ ṣaṭpaṃcaika samanvitaṃ | anantādhāragaṃbhīraṃ aṣṭatriṃśavibhūṣitaṃ ||
paṃcabhirvā prasiddhyarthaṃ pūrṇantena niruntaraṃ | evaṃ dhyānaparo yastu sabāhyābhyantarāmṛtaṃ ||
vikṣobhyakalaśaṃ mūrddhni daiśiko maṃtra tatparaḥ | anugraha sadāvasthastvabhiṣiṃcet prayatnataḥ ||
samucyatena saṃdeho saṃsārāddurati kramāt | āyurbalaṃ yaśaḥ kīrti dhṛtirmedhā yaśaḥ śriyaḥ ||
<15b>
sarvaṃ pravarddhate yasya bhūbhṛtorājyamuttamaṃ | duḥkhānvito viduḥkhastu vyādhimānnimujo bhavet ||
baṃdhyāpi labhate putraṃ kanyā tu patimāvahet | yayatsamīhate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ tasya dhruvaṃ bhavet ||
abhiṣekasya māhātmyaṃ vidhāna vihitasya ca | kathitaṃ te mayā devi pūjanaṃ hitakāmyayā ||
anyaśāstropacāreṇa sarvaśāntyāraho bhavet | evaṃ sthūlavidhānaṃ tu sūkṣmaṃ caivādhunā śṛṇu ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛteśavidhāne [sthaladhikāra ṣaṣṭhamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || īśvara uvāca ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhyānaṃ sūkṣmamanuttamaṃ | ṛtu ṣaṣṭya svarādhāraṃ trilakṣaṃ vyomapaṃcakaṃ ||
graṃthidvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ śaktitrayasamanvitam | dhāmatraya pathākrāntaṃ nāḍitrayasamanvitaṃ ||
jñātvā śarīraṃ suśroṇi daśanāḍi pathānugaṃ |
<16a>
dvāsaptati sahasraistu saptakoṭyārddhasaṃyutaṃ | nāḍivṛṃdaiḥ samākrāntaṃ anale vyādhibhiḥ kṛtaṃ ||
sūkṣmadhyānāmṛtenaiva pareṇaivoditena tu | āpyāyaṃ kurute yogī ātmānotha parasya vā ||
divyadehastu bhavati sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ | yat svarūpaṃ svasaṃvedyaṃ svasthasvavyāpti saṃbhavaṃ ||
svoditā tu parāśakti svasthā tadgarbhagaḥ śivaḥ | tāṃ vadvenmadhyame prāṇe prāṇāpānāṃtare dhruvaṃ ||
ahaṃ bhūtvā tato maṃtraṃ tatsthaṃ taccakragaṃ dhruvaṃ | svoditena varārohe spaṃdanaṃ spadanena tu ||
kṛtvā tadabhimānaṃ tu janmasthāne nidhāpayet | bhāvabhedena tatsthānāmmūlādhāre prayojayet ||
nādasūcyāprayogena vedhayet sūkṣmayogataḥ | ādhāraḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ bhitvā graṃthidvādaśakaṃ tathā ||
madhyanāḍipathārūḍho vedhayet paramaṃ dhruvaṃ | tatpraviṣṭastadā bhūtvā tatsamo vyāpakaḥ śivaḥ ||
sarvāmayaparityāgānniṣkalaṃ kṣobhyaśaktitaḥ |
<16b>
punarāpyāyatenaiva mārgeṇa hṛdayāntaraṃ | tatra praviṣṭamātrastu dhyānālabdhaṃ rasāyanaṃ ||
viśrāmyā tu bhavaṃ prāpya tasmāt sthānāt pravāhayet | sarvaṃ tadamṛtaṃ vegān sarvatraiva nirodhayet ||
anantanāḍi bhedena hyanantāmṛtamuttamaṃ | ananta dhyānayogena paripūryasvakaṃpuraṃ ||
bhuktvā jarāmarastadvat sabāhyābhyantaraṃ priye | evaṃ mṛtyujitāt sarvaṃ sūkṣmanādena pūritaṃ ||
tadāsau siddhyate kṣipraṃ satyaṃ devi na cānyathā | janmasthānaṃ samāśṛtya spaṃdasthaṃ madhyamāṃ kalāṃ ||
tatsthaṃ kṛtvā tadātmānaṃ kālāgniṃ tu samāśrayet | gatvā gṛhīta vijñānaṃ vīryaṃ tatraiva nikṣipet ||
tadvīryāt paramāṃ śaktiṃ kriyākhyā madhyamoditā | vijñānenordhvato bhinnā graṃthibhedena cecchayā ||
mūlaspaṃdaṃ samāśṛtya tyaktvā bāhu dvayaṃ tataḥ | pratha(?)mārgapravāhena suṣumnākhyaṃ samāśrayet ||
<17a>
tadevāśṛtya viramet tat sarveṃdriya gocare | tadā pratyastame naiva vijñānenorddhataḥ kramāt ||
brahmādi kāraṇānāṃ tu tyāgaṃ kṛtvā śanaiḥśanaiḥ | ṣaṣṭyāṃśaktimataḥ prāpya kuṃḍalākhyāṃ nirodhikāṃ ||
māyādi graṃthibhedena hṛdyādauvyamapaṃcakaṃ | janmamūle samayākhyā graṃthijanmani pāśataḥ ||
brahmāviṣṇustathā rudra īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ | kāraṇasthā tu paṃcaivaṃ graṃthādau samudāhṛtaṃ ||
iṃdikākhyā tu yā graṃthirvimārgestanmanā tu sā | tadūrddhvaṃ dīpikā caiva tadūrdhe caiva vai dadhī ||
nādākhyā tu mahāgraṃthi śaktigraṃthistvataḥ param | graṃthirdvādaśakaṃ bhitvā praviśet paramaṃ śivaṃ ||
brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ caiveśvarastathā | sadāśivaṃ tathā śaktiṃ śivasthānaṃ prabhedayet ||
khamanaṃtaṃ tu janmākhye nābhau vyoma dvitīyakaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ tu hṛdi sthāne caturthīṃ caṃdramadhyataḥ ||
nādākhyaṃ tu samuddiṣṭaṃ ṣaṭcakramadhunocyate |
<17b>
janmākhyaṃ nāḍicakraṃ tu nābhau māyākhyamuttamaṃ | hṛdisthaṃ yogicakraṃ tu tā īlusthaṃ bhedanaṃ smṛtaṃ ||
viṃdusthaṃ bhedacakraṃ ca nādasthaṃ śāntamucyate | pūrvoktāni ca sarvāṇi jñānaśūlena bhedayet ||
ākramyādhāra janmākhyaṃ tanmūlaṃ pīḍayecchanaiḥ | tasyādhārasya suśroṇi paryāyācchṛṇvataḥ paraṃ ||
janmasthānaṃ tu kūrmākhyaṃ kūmākhyaṃ sthānapaṃcakaṃ | matsyodaraṃ tathaivaṃ hi mūlādhāraṃ taducyate ||
tasmāt tāṃ khecarākhyāṃ tu mudrāṃ viṃdeta yogavit | mudrāyā tu tadā devi ātmā vai mudrito yadā ||
tadā cordhvaṃ tu vicaredvijñāne nordhvataḥ kramāt | vidvyādbhiṃdyātparaṃ yāvat sthānaṃ suravarārcitaṃ ||
tasthānaṃ devi saṃprāpya yoginī samarasī bhavet | niṣkalaṃ bhāvamāpanno vyāpakaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ ||
evaṃ bhūtvā samaṃ sarvaṃ nispaṃdaṃ sarvatodita | tataḥ pravartate śaktirlakṣahīnā nirāmayā ||
<18a>
icchāmātravinirdiṣṭā jñānarūpā kriyātmikā | ekā sā bhāvabhedena tasya bhedena saṃsthitā ||
khecarī mudrayā pūrya śaktyantaṃ tatra sarvataḥ | yāvaccanoditaścaṃdrastāvan śūnyaṃ niraṃjanaṃ ||
bhāvagrāhyasamākīrṇaṃ sarvāvasthojjhitaṃ paraṃ | vyāpakaṃ parameśānaṃ anaupamya manāmayaṃ ||
bhavanti yoginastatra tadārūḍhā varānane | sā yoniḥ sarvadevānāṃ śaktīnāṃ vyāpyasarvataḥ ||
agnīṣomātmikā yoni tasmāt sarvaṃ pravartate | tatra saṃgraṃthitā maṃtrā trāṇavanto bhavanti te ||
sarveṣāṃ caiva saṃhāraṃ tadeva paramaṃ padaṃ | tasmāt pravartate sṛṣṭi vikṣobhya paramaṃ śivaṃ ||
anaupamyāmṛtaṃ prāpya biṃduṃ vikṣobhya līlayā | caṃdrodayaṃ tathā khyātaṃ paramāmṛtamuttamaṃ ||
vahalāmṛtakallola anantaṃ tatra saṃsmaret | tasmāt prāpyāmṛtaṃ śubhraṃ svaśaktyā caiva karṣayet ||
madhyamārgeṇa suśroṇi kāraṇāni prabhedayet | āpyāyanaṃ prakurvīta sthāne sthānepyanukramāt ||
<18b>
yāvadbrahmapadaṃ prāptaṃ tasmādāpyāyayedadhaḥ | janmasthāna padā caiva kālāgnau ca pracakramet ||
tadā pūryasamatāṃ tu paripūrṇaṃ smaret punaḥ | suṣumnāmṛtenākhilaṃ tu paripūrṇaṃ vibhāvayet ||
ananta nāḍibhistatra romakūpaiḥ samantataḥ | niṣkrāmya vyāpako bhūtvā khamṛtormi bhirākulaṃ ||
amṛtārṇavasaṃrūḍho majjantamamṛtārṇave | tadūrdhe hyamṛtārṇaṃ tu pradrutaṃ vyāpakaṃ śivaṃ ||
evaṃ samarasī bhūtvā hyamṛtaṃ sarvato mukhaṃ | icchājñānakriyārūpaṃ śivamātmasvakaṃ vibhum ||
nirāmayamanuprāpya svānubhūtaṃ vibhāvayet | amṛteśa padaṃ sūkṣmaṃ saṃprāpye vāmṛtī bhavet ||
tadāsau hyamṛtī bhūtvā mṛtyujinnātrasaṃśayaḥ | kālajit subhago vīro mṛtyustasya na bādhate ||
kālasya vaṃcanaṃ sūkṣmaṃ mayā te prakaṭīkṛtaṃ | na kasya cinmayā khyātaṃ tvadṛte bhaktivatsale ||
<19a>
iti amṛteśavidhāne [sūkṣmadhyānādhikāraḥ saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ || bhagavānuvāca] ||
atha mṛtyuṃjaya nityaṃ paracaivādhunocyate | yaṃ prāpya na nivartante saṃsāre tṛvidhe priye ||
yogī sarvagato bhāti sarvadṛk sarvakṛcchivaḥ | tamahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yasmādanyanna vidyate ||
yaṃ prāpyate tanmayatvena bhavate hyajarāmaraḥ | pannavāgvadate nityaṃ yanna dṛśyeta cakṣuṣā ||
yanna saṃśrūyate karṇairbhāsāyaśca na jighrati | na cārddhaṃ(?) svādayate jihvā na sparśeta tvagiṃdṛyaṃ ||
na cetasā cintanīyaṃ sarvavarṇa rasojjhitaṃ | sarvavarṇa rasairyuktamaprameyamatīṃdriyaṃ ||
yaṃ prāpyayogino devi bhavanti hyajarāmarāḥ | tadabhyāsena mahatā vairāgyena pareṇa ca ||
rāgadveṣaparityāgā lobhamohakṣayāt priye | madamātsarya saṃtyāgānmānagarvatamojjhitān ||
labhate śāśvato nityaṃ śivamadhyayamuttamaṃ |
<19b>
nimiṣonmeṣamātraṃ tu yadi cailopalabhyate | tataḥ prabhṛti muktosau na punarjanmamāpnuyāt ||
aṣṭāṃgena tu yogena prāpnuyānānyathā kvacit | saṃsāre viratirnityaṃ yamaḥ paramudāhṛtaḥ ||
bhāvanā tu pare tatve nityaṃ niyama ucyate | madhyamaprāṇamāśritya prāṇāpānapathāntaraṃ ||
ālaṃvyajñānaśaktiṃ ca tatsthaṃ caivāsanaṃ bhavet | prāṇādi sthūla bhāvaṃ tu tyaktvā sūkṣmaṃ pathāṃtaraṃ ||
sūkṣmātītaṃ tu paramaṃ spaṃdanaṃ labhyate yataḥ | prāṇāyāmasamuddiṣṭo yasmānna cyavate manaḥ ||
śabdādi guṇaṃ vṛttiryā cetasā hyanubhūyate | tyaktvā tāṃ paramaṃ dhāma praviśet tat svacetasā ||
pratyāhāramiti proktaṃ bhavapāśanikṛntanaṃ | dhīrguṇātsamatiṃ kramya nirguṇaṃ cāvyayaṃ vibhu ||
dhyātvā dhyeyaṃ svasaṃvedyaṃ dhyānaṃ tacca vidurbudhāḥ | dhāraṇā paramātmānaṃ dhāryate yena sarvadā ||
dhāraṇā sā vinirdiṣṭā bhavavaṃdhavināśanī |
<20a>
samassarveṣu bhūteṣu ādhāraṃ cintavigrahaṃ | samādhānamiti proktamanyathā lokadāṃbhikaṃ ||
svaparastheṣu bhūteṣu jagatyasminsamānadhīḥ | śivohama dvitīyohaṃ samādhissa parasmṛta ||
samyak svarūpaṃ saṃvedyaṃ saṃvidrūpaṃ svabhāvajaṃ | svasaṃvedyaṃ svarūpaṃ ca samādhānaṃ paraṃ viduḥ ||
rāśibhyāṃ vijjaḍābhyāṃ ca vicārya nipuṇaṃ padaṃ | yadevaṃ śāśvataṃ rūpaṃ samādhānaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ ||
evamaṣṭāṃga yogena svabhāvasthaṃ paraṃ dhruvaṃ | dṛṣṭvāṃvacayate kālaṃ mamṛteśaṃ paraṃ vibhuṃ ||
mṛtyujit sa bhaved devi na kālaḥ kalayecca taṃ | tattva ṣaṭtṛṃśa tastyāgādbhūvanānaṃtyavarjanāt ||
ekāśīti padordhvaṃ vai varṇapaṃcāśataḥ paraṃ | vyāpakaṃ sarvataṃtreṣu sarveṣveva hi jīvanaṃ ||
aṣṭātṛṃśatkalordhve tu sarvāntassarvamadhyagaḥ | ādi madhyaṃ na caivāntaṃ labhyate yasya kasyacit ||
tama prameyamatulaṃ prāpyasarvaṃ na vidyate | yenaikena jagatsarvaṃ marameyena pūritaṃ ||
<20b> taṃ jñātvā mucyate kṣipraṃ ghorāt saṃsārabaṃdhanāt | tatvatrayavinirmuktaṃ śāśvataṃ hyacalaṃ dhruvaṃ ||
divyena yogamārgeṇa dṛṣṭvā bhūyo na jāyate | sarveṃdriyavinirmuktaṃ viśvarūpamanāmayaṃ ||
paramātmasvarūpaṃ tu sarvopādhivivarjitaṃ | caitanyamātmanorūpaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu kathyate ||
nirmalaṃ na bhaved devi yāvacchaktyā na śodhitaṃ | dīkṣā jñānāgninā śodhyamātmānaṃ caiva nirmalaṃ ||
ye viṃdaṃti na caivānyaṃ viṃdanti paramaṃ padaṃ | tenātmopāsakāścaiva gacchanti paramaṃ śivaṃ ||
yadā tu paramāśaktissarvajñādiṣu guṇānvitā | āpādādi vikāsinyā na vikāmyeti nirmalā ||
yāvanna nirmalo hyātmā baddhaḥ śaive taducyate |
<21a>
yatrasthaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvaṃ vetyatītamanāgataṃ | sanniyamyeṃdṛyagrāmaṃ tattatvaṃ śaktilakṣaṇaṃ ||
yatra yatra bhavedicchā jñānaṃ vāpi pravartate | kṛyākṛtya svarūpā vā tattatvaṃ śakti lakṣaṇaṃ ||
vyāpakasya sato devi cidrūpasyātmanaḥ śivān | prasaratyadbhūtānaṃdā sā śaktiḥ paramādbhūtā ||
viprasāryatavātmānaṃ sarvajñādi guṇairguṇī | sābhāsaḥ kathyate devi śivaḥ paramakāraṇaḥ ||
sarvajñaḥ paritṛptaśca yaśca bodho hyavādimān | svataṃtro hyapraluptaśca yaśca vānantaśaktitaḥ ||
śaktimān guṇabhedena saguṇānviṃdate guṇī | pṛthagbhedavibhedena nānātvaṃ vicarediha ||
sarvābhāsa iti prokto nirābhāsastu kathyate |
<21b>
nāhamasti na caidānyo(?) nirābhāso yathā bhavet | sāvasthā paramā proktā śivasya paramātmanaḥ ||
nāhamasti na cānyosti dhyeyaṃ cātra vidyate | ānaṃdapadasaṃlīnaṃ jñānaṃ samarasī gataṃ ||
nordhve dhyānaṃ prayuṃjīta nādhastānna ca madhyataḥ | nāgrataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ kiṃcit pārśvayorubhayorapi ||
nāntaḥ śarīrasaṃsthaṃ tu na bāhye bhāvayet kvacit | nākāśe badhyate lakṣaṃ nādho dṛṣṭiṃ niveśayet ||
na cakṣurmīlanaṃ kiṃci na kiṃci dṛṣṭi baṃdhanaṃ | avalaṃbaṃ nirālaṃbaṃ sāvalaṃbaṃ na bhāvayet ||
naṃdṛyāṇi bhūtāni śabdasparśarasādinā | sarvaṃ tyaktvā samādhisthaḥ kevalanmayo bhavet ||
sāvasthā paramā proktā śivasya paramātmanaḥ | nirābhāsa pade taṃ tu taṃ prāpya vinivartate ||
evaṃ bhāvitamātmānamātmano bhāvanā balāt | sa bhavet paramaṃ śāntaṃ śivamatyaṃta nirmalaṃ ||
tadeka tatvaṃ sarva ca bhavate mṛtyujicchivaṃ |
<22a>
sa cāmṛtīśaṃ paramaṃ tṛtīyaṃ padamuttamaṃ | ākhyātaṃ tava deveśi kimanyat kathayāmi te ||
evaṃ mṛtyujitāt sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ jñātvā vimucyate | sarvakāle tu kālasya vaṃcanaṃ kathitaṃ pṛye ||
evaṃ tu trividhaṃ devi mayāte prakaṭīkṛtaṃ | kālasya vaṃcanaṃ nāma yogaṃ paramadurlabhaṃ ||
anenābhyāsayogena mṛtyujidbhavate naraḥ | anenaiva tu yogena lokānugrahakāmyayā ||
mṛtyujidbhavate yogī sarvaprāṇiṣu sarvadā | evaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ khyātaṃ śāśvataṃ paramaṃ dhruvaṃ ||
asmāt parataraṃ nāsti satyametadudāhṛtaṃ | yatparāmṛtarūpaṃ tu trividhaṃ coditaṃ mayā ||
tadabhyāsād bhave jaṃturātmanopi parasya vā | amṛtīśa samodevi mṛtyujinnātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
yena yena prakāreṇa yatra yatraiva saṃsmaret | tena tena prakāreṇa sa yogīkālajidbhavet ||
yatra yatra sthito vāpi yena yena vratena ca |
<22b>
yena yena hi yogena bhāvabhedena siddhyati | tadekaṃ bahudhā devi vidhyātaṃ vai siddhidaṃ bhavet ||
dvaitādvaite vimiśre vā ekavīrethayāmale | sarvassarvaprakāreṇa sarvathā siddho bhavet ||
cintarantaṃ yathā loke cintitārtha phalapradaṃ | tathaiṣamaṃtrarājastu cintitārthavidhāyakaḥ ||
maṃtrāṇāṃ saptakoṭīnāṃ mālayaḥ paramo balī | bhāvahīnāstu ye maṃtrā śaktihīnāstu kīlitāḥ ||
varṇamātravihīnāstu gurvāgamanavivarjitāḥ | bhraṣṭāmnāyavihīnāyepyāgamojjhitavighnitāḥ ||
na siddhyanti yathā devi japtvā yaṣṭvā sahasraśaḥ | asiddhā ṛpavo ye ca sarvaśaṃkāvivarjitāḥ ||
ādyantasaṃpuṭe naiva sādhyarṇena tu roditāḥ | maṃtrenānena deveśi amṛtīśena dīpitāḥ ||
siddhyanti hyaprayatnena yaṣṭājaptā na saṃśayaḥ | dhyātā sarvapradā devi bhavantenānṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||
<23a>
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ pṛye ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [kālavaṃcano nāmāṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || śrīdevyuvāca ||
śrutaṃ mayā mahādeva māhātmyaṃ maṃtranāyakaṃ | adhunā śrotumicchāmi yaduktaṃ vidhunā mama ||
sarvāgamavidhānena bhāvabhedena siddhidaṃ | vāmadakṣiṇasiddhānta sauravaiṣṇavavaidike ||
yatheṣṭasiddhido devo yatheṣṭācarayogataḥ | tadākhyā hi sureśāna cintārantaphalodayaṃ ||
bhagavānuvāca ||
śṛṇu suṃdari tatvena paramārthaṃ vadāmi te | amṛtīśavidhānena mṛtyujit kathitaṃ mayā ||
tadeva paramaṃ devi śivaṃ sūkṣmamanāmayaṃ | svabhāvatatsamuddiṣṭaṃ vyāpakaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvaṃ ||
na tasya rūpaṃ varṇaṃ vā paramārtha vadāmi te | yasmāt sarvagataṃ devaṃ sarvāgamamayaṃ śubhaṃ ||
vyāpakaṃ sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ sarvasi (*) phalapradaṃ | nirmalaṃ sphaṭikaṃ yadvat taṃ tu proktaṃ sitādikaṃ ||
<23b>
praticiṃcetasarvatraye nayena hiraṃjitaḥ | tattadarśayatītyevaṃ nastva(?) bhāvena raṃjitaṃ ||
yathā tathaiva deveśi sarvāgama niyojitaḥ | phalaṃ dadāti sarveṣāṃ sādhakānāṃ hi sarvataḥ ||
tasmāt srotaḥ susarveṣu cintāmaṇirivojvalaḥ | bhāvabhedena vai dhyātassarvakāmaphalapradaḥ ||
śivassadāśivaścaiva bhairavastuṃburustathā | somasūryasvarūpeṇa vahnirūpadharovibhuḥ ||
yato jñānamayaṃ devaṃ jñeyaṃ ca bahudhā sthitaṃ | niyaṃtritānāṃ baddhānāṃ trāṇantannetra mucyate ||
mṛtyoruntārayed yasmāt mṛtyujitena bodhyate | amṛtatvaṃdayatye(?) tadamṛtīśa iti smṛtaḥ ||
evaṃ sarvagato devo bahūrūpo maṇiryathā | sarvaicārādhito devi svasiddhaphalavāṃchayā ||
sarveṣāṃ phalado deva prārthitārthavidhāyakaḥ |
<24a>
tasmādbhāvānurūpeṇa sādhakassādhane sthitaḥ | yena yenaiva bhāvena tasya tatphalado bhavet ||
yatsadāśivarūpeṇa sadā dhyāyati sādhakaḥ | sadāśiva tanustasya bhavate parameśvari ||
sarvasādhāraṇo hyeṣa sarvānugrahakārakaḥ | sadyo vāmo hyaghoraśca puruṣeśānavigrahaḥ ||
anena hṛdayādīninyastavyāni varānane | anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa svāsanaṃ parikalpayet ||
caṃdrārbudapratīkāśaṃ hi mādrinicayopamaṃ | paṃcavaktraṃ viśālākṣaṃ daśabāhuṃ trilocanaṃ ||
nāgayajñopavītaṃ tu vyāghracarmāṃbaracchadaṃ | baddhapadmāsanāsīnaṃ sitapadmoparisthitaṃ ||
triśūlamutpalaṃ vāṇamakṣasūtraṃ ca mudgaraṃ | dakṣiṇeṣu kāreṣvevaṃ vāmeṣvevamataḥ paraṃ ||
kheṭakādarṣacāpograṃ mātuluṃgaṃ kamaṃḍaluṃ |
<24b>
caṃdrārddhamaulinaṃ devamāpītaṃ pūrvavaktrataḥ | dakṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇantīmograṃ daṃṣṭrālaṃbikṛtānanaṃ ||
kapālamālābharaṇaṃ jagatsaṃtrāsakārakaṃ | paścimaṃ himakuṃdābhaṃ vāmaṃ raktotpalaṃ prabhaṃ ||
ūrdhvavaktraṃ maheśāni sphaṭikābhaṃ vicintayet | evaṃ dhyātvā tu deveśaṃ pūjayed vidhi pūrvakaṃ ||
svamūrtau sthaṃḍile liṃge jale vā kamalopari | īśānādyādi sadyāntā svadikṣu pratipūjayet ||
āgneyyā hṛdādīni nyastvā pūjyānvidhānataḥ | tadā siddhyatya saṃdehaḥ satyametad bravīmite ||
iti mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [sadāśivādhikāro nāma navamaḥ paṭalaḥ || bhagavānuvāca] ||
athedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi bhairavāgama bheditaṃ | bhinnāṃjana vayaprakhyaṃ kalpānta dahanātmakaṃ ||
paṃcavaktraṃ śavārūḍhaṃ daśabāhuṃ bhayānakaṃ | kṣapāmukhaṃ ghorataraṃ garjaṃ taṃ bhīṣaṇasvaraṃ ||
<25a>
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhṛkuṭīkuṭile kṣaṇaṃ | siṃhacarmaparīdhānaṃ vyālahārairvibhūṣitaṃ ||
kapālamālābharaṇaṃ dāritāsyaṃ mahātanuṃ | gajatvāghrāccata(?) tanuṃ śaśāṃkakṛtaśekharaṃ ||
kapālakhaṭvāṃgadharaṃ khaḍga kheṭakadhāriṇaṃ | pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ devaṃ varadābhaya pāṇinaṃ ||
vajrahastāṃ mahāvīraṃ paraśvāyudhapāṇimaṃ | bhairavaṃ pūjayitvā tu tasmāt saṃgagatāṃ smaret ||
pralayāgni samākārāṃ lākṣāsiṃharasaprabhāṃ | ūrdhvakeśāṃ mahākāyāṃ vikarālāṃ subhīṣaṇāṃ ||
mahodarīṃ paṃcavaktrāṃ netratrayavibhūṣitā | nakharālāṃ koṭarākṣīṃ muṃḍamālāvibhūṣitāṃ ||
bhairavokta bhujāṃ devo bhairavāyudhadhāriṇīṃ | icchāśaktiritikhyātāṃ svacchaṃdotsaṃgagāminīṃ ||
aghoreśvarīti vikhyātāṃmīdṛgrūpadharāṃ smaret ||
sarvataṃtreṣu yā proktā pracchannā na sphuṭīkṛtā | mamāśayo(?) tato(?) nābhi lakṣito bhuvi durlabhaḥ ||
<25b>
vyādhi grahaṇādyeṣu(?) padmaneṣu(?) kṣaya hetave | gobrāhmaṇeṣu rakṣārthaṃ śāntipuṣṭau sadā yajet ||
athavā hemakuṃdeṃdu muktāphalasamadyutiṃ | caṃdrakoṭisamaprakhyaṃ sphaṭikābalasannibhaṃ ||
kalpānta dahanaprakhyaṃ japākiṃśukasannibhaṃ | sūryakoṭisamākāraṃ raktaṃ vā tamanusmaret ||
athavā padmarāgābhaṃ haritātmasamadyutiṃ | icchārūpadharaṃ devamicchāsiddhipradāyakaṃ ||
yādṛśe naiva varṇadhvā sādhakastu manusmaret | tādṛśaṃ bhavate rūpaṃ tādṛk siddhi pradaṃ śubhaṃ ||
padmamadhye sthitaṃ dhyāye pūjayed vidhinā tataḥ | yathānurūpa naivedya puṣpadhūpā sadai(?)rvibhuṃ ||
yā kṣīrasadṛśīṃ devīṃ harahāsasamaprabhāṃ | viśuddhasphaṭikaprakhyāṃ kuṃdeṃdu śaśinirmalaṃ ||
caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ tu cakraikena vibhūṣitāṃ | sitāṃbaradharāṃ devīṃ sitahāravibhūṣitāṃ ||
<26a>
sāraṃgāsanasaṃsthā tu vajrahastāṃ mahābalāṃ | pāśāṃkuśadharīṃ devīṃ ghaṃṭādhvani nināditāṃ ||
pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃsthā tu devadevasya sanmukhaṃ | dhyāyate yastu yuktātmā kṣipraṃ sidhyati sādhakaḥ ||
sūryakoṭisamaprakhyāṃ jvalitāgni samaprabhaṃ | siṃdūrarāśisadṛśīṃ vidyudrūpāṃ bhayaṃkarīṃ ||
trinetrāṃ bhīmavadanāṃ sthūlakāyāṃ mahodarīṃ | laṃbodarīṃ laṃbakucāṃ pretārūḍhāṃ mahābalāṃ ||
kapālamālā bharaṇāṃ vyāghracarmakaṭisthalāṃ | gajacarmottarīyāṃ ca muṃḍamālāvibhūṣitāṃ ||
mahoklevavirājadantīṃ bhāsayantīṃ diśombaraṃ | caturbhujaikavaktrāṃ tu khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīṃ ||
kapālakhaṭvāṃgadharīṃ dakṣa diksaṃsthitāṃ smaret | kṛṣṇāruṇāṃ mahādīptāṃ nirmāṃsāṃ vikṛtānanāṃ ||
suśuskakoṭarākṣīṃra ekavaktrāṃ caturbhujāṃ | trinetrāṃ bhīmavadanāṃ vyālahārairvibhūṣitaṃ ||
ūrdhvakeśāṃ mahākāyāṃ muṃḍamālāvibhūṣitāṃ |
<26b>
snāyurajju nibaddhvāṃgīṃ naracarmakaṭisthalā | vyāghracarmāṃbara dharāṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīṃ ||
aṃtrāsṛṅmāṃsasaṃpūrṇaṃ piṭikāṃ dhārayet sadā | troṭayantīṃ mahāṃtrāṇi paścimāyāṃ diśi smaret ||
kuṃbhīrāsanasaṃsthā tu(?) sa(?) caivamadhunocyate | uṣṭragrīvaṃ gajaskaṃdhamaśvakarṇaṃ huḍānanaṃ ||
vyāḍajaṃghasamākāraṃ nakhāvajrāyudhopamāḥ | kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ mīnapucchaṃ kuṃbhīraṃ parikīrtitaṃ ||
nīlotpaladalaśyāmāṃ śaradaṃbudasannibhāṃ | trinetrāṃ caika vaktrāṃ ca nīlāṃbaravibhūṣitāṃ ||
siṃhapṛṣṭhe samārūḍhāṃ śaracāpa karodyatāṃ | śaktihastāṃ mahādevīṃ tathā cotpalahastikā ||
diśyuttarasyāṃ deveśī dhyātāṃ yaṣṭāṃ phalapradāṃ | siddhāraktā tathā śuṣkā tathaivotpalamālinī ||
caturdikṣu sthitā hyetā bhairavāpātugāḥ priye | vidikṣu dūtyodinyasya(?) vahnādīśaṃ digantataḥ ||
<27a>
kālī caiva karālī ca mahākālī tathaiva (*) | bhadrakālīti vikhyātā devī rūpeṇa saṃsthitā ||
kiṃ tvetā dvibhujādevya padmāsanamavasthitāḥ | kartṛkā muṃḍadhāriṇyaḥ kiṃkarā dvāradeśataḥ ||
krodhanovṛttakaścaiva karṣaṇotha gajānanaḥ | dvibhujā vikṛtāsyāstu khaḍgakheṭakapāṇayaḥ ||
śāntyarthe tu sitāḥ sarve rūpaṃ vā karmabhedataḥ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rājarajyāvidhānataḥ ||
maṃtrasaṃpuṭayogena madhye nāmasamālikhet | taddharthi bhairavaṃ devamamṛteśaṃ yajet pṛye ||
devyodaleṣu tenaiva tathaivādyaṃtvayojitāṃ | dūtyastathā niyojyante mūlamaṃtreṇa kiṃ karāḥ ||
padmabāhye suśuklaṃ tu likhetru(?)śaśimaṃḍalaṃ | catuṣkoṇaṃ tato bāhye vaktalāṃchanalāṃchitaṃ ||
rocanā kuṃkumenaiva kṣīreṇa sitayā piva | likhitvā pūjayecchāṃtau sarvaśvetopacārataḥ ||
yathā tu rūpairnaivedyairghasmarairvalirāsavaiḥ |
<27b>
sitacaṃdanasaṃmiśraṃ karpūrakṣodadhūsaraṃ | sākṣatātaṃdrulatilātsitaśarkarayā saha ||
ghṛtakṣīrasamāyuktān homayedyaṃstuyantīḥ(?) | mahāśāntirbhavet kṣipraṃ gṛhīto yadi mṛtyunā ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛteśavidhāne [dakṣiṇavaktrādhikāro nāma daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || bhagavānuvāca ||
athedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi tantrottaramanuttamaṃ | maṃtreṇānena yaṣṭavyaṃ sarvasiddhiphalodayaṃ ||
sarvopadrava śāntyarthamaṣṭapatre kuśeśaye | pūrvoktamaṃḍale devi madhye devaṃ tu tuṃburuṃ ||
daśabāhuṃ surāśānaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ trilocanaṃ | sadāśivena vapuṣā vaktrānyevaṃ prakalpayet ||
tamarddhacaṃdraśirasaṃ rājīvāsanasaṃsthitaṃ | himakuṃdeṃdu dhavalaṃ tu di(?)nābalasannibhaṃ ||
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca sarvabhūṣaṇbhūṣitaṃ | sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vyāghracarma kaṭisthalaṃ ||
<28a>
gajacarmaparīdhānaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ mahābalaṃ | khaḍgacarmadharaṃ devaṃ ṭaṃkakaṃdalabhūṣitaṃ ||
pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ devaṃ cakrahastākṣa sūtradhṛk | varadābhayahastaṃ ca sarvakilviṣanāśanaṃ ||
caturdikṣu sthitā devyaḥ pūrvādyā dūtayastathā | āgneyādi vidikṣvevaṃ kiṃkarā dvāradeśataḥ ||
jaṃbhanī mohanī caiva subhagā durbhagāntimāḥ | dūtayastu samākhyātā kiṃkarāḥ śṛṇutaḥ pṛye ||
krodhano nṛttakaścaiva gajakarṇo mahābalaḥ | savyāpasavye gāyatrī sāvitrī viniveśayet ||
adhordhve cāṃkuśaṃ māyāṃ vinyaset tadanantaraṃ | sarvādyetāni yojyāni mūlamaṃtreṇa sarvadā ||
sitaraktapītakṛṣṇā devyo vai caturānanā | caturbhujāḥ trinetrā ca ṭaṃkakaṃdaladhāriṇī ||
daṃḍāśca sūtrahastāśca pretoparivirājate | jayā devī ca vijayā vaktravarṇā caturbhujā ||
catuvaktrāstrinetrā ca śarakārmuka dhāriṇī |
<28b>
khaḍgacarmadharī devī hyulro(?)koparisaṃsthitā | jayantī padmagarbhāśca caturvastrā caturbhujā ||
śaktighaṃṭādharī devī carmapaṭṭisadhāriṇī | aśvārūḍhā mahādevī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ||
ajitā ca catuvaktrā kṛṣṇavarṇā mahābalā | caturbhujā trinetrā ca pāśāṃkuśadharā tathā ||
ratnapātra gadāhastā divyāsanasusaṃsthitā | sauvarṇāṃ caradhāriṇyo svarṇabhūṣaṇa bhūṣitāḥ ||
svadikṣusaṃsthitā yaṣṭā dhyātāsiddhiphalapradā | dūtyastadrūpadhāriṇyo kiṃtu vaktraika bhūṣitāḥ ||
dvibhujāśca trinetrāśca muṃḍakartaribhūṣitāḥ | matsyaḥ kūrmothamakarobhekamāsāṃ tathāsanaṃ ||
kiṃkarāḥ khaḍgahastāśca dvibhujāścarmadhāriṇaḥ | ekavaktrāstrinetrāśca bhṛkuṭī kuṭilekṣaṇāḥ ||
sitādi varṇabhedena dhyātāsiddhipradāṃ śubhāṃ | gāyatrī raktavarṇā ca vaktraikena vibhūṣitā ||
vadvapadmāsanāsīnā dhyānānmīlita locanā |
<29a>
sāvitrīsitavarṇena dhyānāntargata locanā | tathaivā vayavā devī māyākṛṣṇā caturbhujā ||
mahāpaṭṭāvagūhinyā saṃpuṭākārayugmataḥ | aṃkuśaṃ bhairavākāraṃ pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ vibhuṃ ||
kapālakhaṭvāṃgadharaṃ vasāsṛṅmāṃsa laṃpaṭaṃ | rāvaṃkṣīrārṇavaṃ vorvī śaktimādhārikāṃ śubhāṃ ||
āsanārthaṃ prayuṃjīta sarvaśāntyarthasādhakaṃ | sarvāṇyetāni vā devi suśuklāḥ śāntikārakāḥ ||
raktāpītāstathā kṛṣṇā dhyātavyāḥ karmabhedataḥ | tadvat pūjāṃ prakurvīta yadāsiddhiphalapradāḥ ||
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi cakrarājaṃ mahābalaṃ | ādyantasaṃpuṭe caiva madhye nāma samālikhet ||
evaṃ devyaśca dūtyaśca pūrvavad vidhinā smaret | madhye daleṣu vidaleṣvanyataḥ sarvataḥ sudhīḥ ||
yathānurūpa naivedyairbhūriśāntyarthamātmanaḥ | anyasya cātrayoktavyaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ śāntikarmaṇi ||
<29b>
tilataṃḍulamadhvājya kṣīraśarkarayā saha | homayet pūrvavat kuṃḍe praśasteṃdhana dīpite ||
mahāśāntiḥ prajāyeta (*?) menānṛtaṃ vacaḥ | sarvarakṣāvidhānestu yojyādevyaḥ susiddhidāḥ ||
paṃktisthā vāyajed devīṃ madhye devaṃ tu tuṃburuṃ | sarvaśreyassamāpnoti sādhakaḥ saṃya (*?) dṛyaḥ ||
anyasya vā prayuṃjāno jayatyanaṃ saṃśayaḥ |
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśaṃ vidhāne [uttaratantrādhikāre ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || bhagavānuvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kulāmnāya nidarśanaṃ | yāgahomaṃ japaṃ kāryaṃ yena sarvamavāpnuyāt ||
padmamadhye tu saṃpū (*?) bhairavaḥ pūrvacoditaḥ | pūrvādi digdalāntasthā hyaṣṭau devya svabhāvataḥ ||
brahmyādi devatānāṃ ca svarūpāyudhavāhanāḥ | brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣaṇavī tathā ||
<30a
vārāhī caiva māheṃdrī cāmuṃḍā bahurūpiṇī | brahmādi bahurūpāntaṃ rūpamāsāṃ svavāhanaṃ ||
haṃso vṛṣo mayūraśca vainateyaśca sīkaraḥ | (**?) naityovāhanāni proktā nyāsāṃ krameṇa tu ||
svāyudhaṃ caiva sarvāsāṃ svarūpāṃkuśabhūṣitāṃ | kapālakhaṭvāṃga dharā varadā bhayahastikā ||
paṃktisthā vā (*) je devi sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradā | sarveṣāṃ caiva śāntyarthaṃ prāṇināṃ bhūtimicchatā ||
bhūriyāgena yaṣṭavyā yathākarmānurūpataḥ | viśeṣena tu ṣaṣṭyavya bhūbhṛtānāṃ tu daiśikaiḥ ||
āsāmeva prasādena rājyaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam | bhuṃjate sarvarājāna subhagā hyavanītale ||
yasmādeta jagatsarvaṃ devīnāṃ bhāvajaṃ | etā yoni svarūpāstu devādi jagataḥ priye ||
sarvāstāḥ sarvaduḥkhaugha hāriṇyaḥ prāṇināṃ pṛye | rakṣanti mātṛvaccaitāḥ pālayanti (**?) tsadā ||
<30b>
koṣṭhe vai kārṣikānyadvacchakti rūpaṃ jagat priye | pralayedhārayantissasṛjantīha punaścatāḥ ||
yadvacca kārṣakāḥ kāle bījavāpaṃ prakurvati | phalārthaṃ phaladaṃ tadvadbrahmakalpasisṛkṣayā ||
kalpādau kalpamadhyānte vyāpayanti jagaddhitāḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śāntyarthaṃ hitakāmyayā ||
yaṣṭavyāścaiva hotavyā dhyātavyāssiddhikāmataḥ | sarvabījaistrimadhoktaistilairvā śrīphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
puṣpairvā supraśastaiśca phalairanyaiḥ suhomi (*?) taiḥ | sarvasiddhipradādevyaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyuṃjidamṛtīśavidhāne [kulāmnāyādhikāro dvādaśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || īśvara uvāca ||
evaṃ vai maṃtrarājasya kaulikaṃ vidhicoditaṃ | punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi vidhānaṃ yatphalaṃ pradaṃ ||
nārāyaṇaṃ caturvāhuṃ padmapatrayate kṣaṇaṃ |
<31a>
atasī puṣpasaṃkāśamekavaktraṃ dvilocanaṃ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadma sarvābharaṇabhūṣiṇaṃ ||
divyāṃvaradharaṃ devaṃ divyapuṣpopaśobhitaṃ | sphuranmutta(?)māṇikya kiṃkiṇī jālamaṃḍitaṃ ||
divyakuṃḍaladhārī ca utthitaṃ tu sadāsmaret | athavā pakṣirājasthaṃ suśvetaṃ tu manoramaṃ ||
trivaktraṃ saumyavadanaṃ varāharibhūṣitaṃ | bhujaiḥ ṣaṭbhisamāyuktaṃ varābhayasamanvitaṃ ||
utsaṃge spa(?)śṛyaṃ dhyāyet tadvarṇāyudhadhāriṇīṃ | lāvaṇyakānti sadṛśī devadevasya sanmukhāṃ ||
(*?) turdikṣu sthitā devyo vidikṣvaṃgāni pūjayet | jayālakṣmīstathā kīrmāyā vaidignatā yajet ||
pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ devīṃ varadābhayapāṇinīṃ | devasya sanmukhā dhyāye śrīvarṇārūpadhāriṇī ||
devasya sadṛśānyaṃgāṣṭadvarṇāyudhadhārakāṃ | athavāṣṭabhujaṃ devaṃ pītavarṇasuśobhanam ||
<31b>
meṣoparisthitaṃ devaṃ digvāsaṃmūrddhaliṃginaṃ | śṛṃgavaṭā(?) (**?) kena coyānovya(?)tapāṇinaṃ ||
bālarūpaṃ yaje nityaṃ krīḍamānaṃ hi yoṣitāṃ | caturdikṣu nyased devīṃ digvāsāstu manoramāḥ ||
karpūrī caṃdanī caiva kastūrī(?) kuṃkumī tathā | tadrūpadhāriṇīṃ devīṃ icchāsiddhiphalapradā ||
bahunātrakimuktena viśra(?)bhugvā sadāsmaret | anekavaktrasaṃghātairanekāsta bhujaistathā ||
śayanaṃ vā vivāhasthaṃ hyadhe lakṣmi yutaṃ tathā | kevalaṃ narasiṃhaṃ vā vārāhaṃ vāthavā smaret ||
kapilānanopi vā dhyāyedavyaktaṃ vāpi niṣkalaṃ | yena yena prakāreṇa bhāvabhedena saṃsmaret ||
tasya tanmayatāṃ yāti ityājñā pārameśvarī | tejomayamatovakṣye yena siddhirbhavernṛṇāṃ ||
raktapadmanibhākāraṃ lākṣārasasamaprabhaṃ | siṃdūrarāsivarṇābhaṃ padmarāgasamaprabhaṃ ||
kusuṃbharasasaṃkāśaṃ dāḍimī kusumaprabhaṃ |
<32a>
kalpāntavahnisadṛśamekavadvaktraṃ dvilocanaṃ | caturbhujaṃ mahātmāna varadābhayapāṇikaṃ ||
vajramekena hastena padmamekena dhārayet | saptāśca rathamārūḍhaṃ nāgayajñopavītanaṃ ||
raktamālyāṃbaradharaṃ rakta sraganulepanaṃ | athavāṣṭabhujaṃ devaṃ lokapālāyudhānvitam ||
trivaktraṃ ghoravadanaṃ trinetraṃ vikṛtānanam | aśvoparisamārūḍhaṃ padmamadhye sadāyajet ||
hṛcchiraśca śikhāvarma locanāstraṃ prapūjayet | madhyapadme yajed devaṃ grahāṣṭau tu dvitīyake ||
nakṣatrāṇi tṛtīye tu ya (*?) saṃkhyaṃ tribhistribhiḥ | dalāgre tṛtayaṃ pūjyaṃ lokapālāṃstato yajet ||
paṃcame padmasaṃsthāne astrāṇyaṣṭau prapūjayet | kevalaṃ sutthitaṃ vāpi dvibhujaṃ raśmi saṃyutaṃ ||
viśvakarmasvarūpaṃ vā viśvakartā jagatpattiḥ | caturbhujaṃ mahātmānaṃ ṭaṃkapustakadhāriṇaṃ ||
<32b>
sādarṣaṃ vāmahastena sūtraṃ vai dakṣiṇena tu | devaiḥ siddhaiśca gaṃdharvaistūyamānaṃ vicintayet ||
sthale nale jale caiva parvatāgreṣu pūjayet | yatra vā rocate cittamicchāsiddhiphalapradaṃ ||
śaṃkhakuṃdeṃdu dhavalaṃ trivaktraṃ rudrarūpiṇaṃ | sadāśivena rūpeṇa vṛṣārūḍhaṃ vicintayet ||
caturbhujaṃ mahātmānaṃ śūlābhayasamanvitaṃ | mātuluṃgadharaṃ devaṃ akṣasūtradharaṃ prabhuṃ ||
athavā bahubāhuṃ ca nādyasthaṃ cintayet prabhuṃ | umārddhadhāriṇaṃ devaṃ viṣṇurevārddhadhāriṇaṃ ||
vivāhaṃ ca vā dhyāyet samīpasthaṃ prapūjayet | brahmā caturmukhaḥ saumyo raktavarṇaḥ sulocanaṃ ||
laṃbakūrcaḥ sutejaskau haṃsārūḍhaścaturbhujaḥ | daṃḍākṣasūtrahastaśca kamaṃḍalubhayapradaḥ ||
<33a>
vedaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktaḥ sarvasiddhiphalapradaḥ | buddhaḥ padmāsanagataḥ pralaṃvaḥ śrutivīvaraḥ ||
padmākṣaḥ padmacihnaśca maṇivaddho jagaddhitaḥ | samādhistho mahāyogī varadābhayapāṇikaḥ ||
akṣasūvadharodevaḥ padmahastaḥ sulocanaḥ | dhyātvā hyevaṃ prapūjyetastrīṇāṃ mokṣaphalapradaḥ ||
bahunātra kimuktena paunaḥ puṇyena suṃdari | kāntikeyaśca kāmaśca somasūryavināyakāḥ ||
lokapālāśca vai sarve hyanyevai devayonayaḥ | gāruḍe bhūtataṃtre ca vāgvidhāneṣu pūjayet ||
nyāyārahanvasāṃkhyaiśca vaidikānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | yāmale ekavīre ca navake tṛkabhedataḥ ||
umārddhadhāriṇe caiva viṣurevārddhadhāriṇe |
<33b>
tatsamīpastha devyo vā durgākhye viṃdhyavāsinī | caṃḍikādyāśca śuṣkādyāḥ svayaṃbhuste maheśvare ||
prākpratiṣṭhitarūpe vā ṛṣirmanujayojite | āyudheṣu ca sarveṣu vidyāpīṭheṣu sarvataḥ ||
pātālamaṃtrataṃtreṣu nāgeṃdradrāviteṣu ca | śaktayo vāpyanantāśva maṃtrenānena suvrate ||
vidhānena tu yaṣṭavyā sarvasiddhiphalapradāḥ | bhavaṃntya vitathaṃ bhadre satyaṃ menānṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||
sarvaṃ sādhāraṇo devaḥ sarvasiddhiphalapradaḥ | sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ jīvabhūto yata smṛtaḥ ||
pratiṣṭhā pūjane caiva bhadrapīṭhārghapātrakaṃ | bāhyasthite sakṛt pūjye sakṛcaṃdrārka mūrtiṣu ||
agnisaṃskaraṇe caiva nyāsadhyānādi vāhanaiḥ | vikalyo naiva kartavyo sarvasādhāraṇo yataḥ ||
saṃkaratvaṃ na jāyeta tasmācchaṃkāṃ parityajet | sakṛjaptaśarīrasthaḥ saṃkṛjjaptorghapātrake ||
<34a>
sakṛddhasteṣu vinyāso mānase tu sakṛjjape | bāhyasthitassakṛtpūjyassakṛcaṃdrārka mūrtiṣu ||
sakṛhome sakṛjjapye udake tu sakṛdyajet | sakṛtsakṛcca sarvatra pūjayet parameśvaraṃ ||
prāṇāyāmādikaṃ kleśa dhāraṇāmudrayogataḥ | naivopayujyate hyasya maṃtrarājasya suvrate ||
vyavasāyaiḥ prakartavyaṃ anyathā naiva siddhyati | nicchidraṃ sādhakeṃdrasya rājye rāṣṭravivṛddhaye ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [sarvavidyādhikārastrayodaśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || śrīdevyuvāca ||
yadi deva paratvena varṇitaṃ maṃtramuttamam | sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ devīnāṃ caiva sarvataḥ ||
hṛdayaṃ paramaṃ hyeṣa maṃtrarāṭsarvasiddhidaṃ | kimanyairmaṃtramukhyaiśca yaṣṭairjaptairvravīhitaṃ ||
bhagavānuvāca ||
sādhusādhumaheśāni pṛṣṭohaṃ yattvayānaghe |
34b)
tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yatsāraṃ paramaṃ dhruvaṃ | āsīdidaṃ śaktirūpaṃ anaupamyamanāmayaṃ ||
śivaṃ sarvagataṃ śuddhaṃmaprameyamatīṃdriyaṃ | sisṛkṣuccecchayā devi jñānaśaktyā kriyātmakaḥ ||
prathamo hyeṣadeveśi sarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ śivaḥ | sarvassarvātmako deva ādisṛṣṭipravartakaḥ ||
tato tu maṃtrasṛṣṭi vai śivena paramātmanā | nānā prakāra racitā pṛthagbheda vyavasthayā ||
yathā tathaiva deveśi sarvaḥ sarvātmakaḥ paraḥ | sādhāraṇo maṃtranāthaḥ sarveṣāṃ caiva vācakaḥ ||
yadā tadā hi sarveṣāṃmātmarūpo hyalepakaḥ | maṃtrakoṭyo hyasaṃkhyātā vyaktāvyaktāśca saṃsthitā ||
sarve te siddhidāstena ādyantena tu rodhitāḥ | etat saṃpuṭayogena japtvāsiddhiphalapradāḥ ||
tadardhaṃ tava suśroṇi snehena prakaṭīkṛtaṃ | rahasyaṃ paramaṃ satyaṃ na śrāvyaṃ yasya kasyacit ||
guptaḥ susiddhido hyeṣa prakaṭaḥ siddhihā bhavet |
<35a>
prathamo hyeṣa deveśi sarvajñaḥ sarvataḥ śivaḥ | sarvaḥ sarvātmako devo ādi sṛṣṭikaraḥ prabhuḥ ||
tadeva maṃtrasṛṣṭiṃ vai śivaṃ vai paramātmanaḥ | nānāprakāra racitā preṣaṃte devyavasthitā ||
tat tat tathaiva deveśi sarvasarvātmakaṃ paraṃ | tasmāt suguptaṃ kartavyaṃ saṃpradāya mukhāgamaḥ ||
iti mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [sarvādhikāro nāma caturdaśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || bhagavānuvāca ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvarakṣākaraṃ yathā | maṃtranāthaṃ mahograṃ ca dhūpaṃ rakṣoghna coditaṃ ||
saptavārābhijaptaṃ tu rakṣoghnaṃ yasya dīyate | śirasthaṃ dhārayennityaṃ sarvadoṣaiḥ pramucyate ||
sarvadaitya kṣayārthaṃ tu samuktenaiva brahmaṇā | serṣāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃmabhicāro yathākṛtaḥ ||
sadā vai sarṣapā proktā pāti rakṣati sarvataḥ | yadā rakṣāṃsi sarvāṇi prāgvivrutahatāni ca ||
mayā devi yadā proktā rakṣoghnā prathitā bhuvi |
<35b>
āhaveṣu ca sarveṣu daityessaha surottamaiḥ | niyuktā duṣṭahantāroṃ siddhyarthaṃ ripunāśanaṃ ||
teṣāmarthaṃ yadāsiddhaṃ tadāsiddhārthakaṃ bhuvi | khyātaṃ darpāpahaṃ devi bhūtānāṃ duṣṭacetasāṃ ||
yadā sarveṣu bhūteṣu bhayatrasteṣṭra(?) sarvataḥ | nairājanavidhānena nāmāṃkaṃ juhuyāt pṛye ||
vahnau saṃkruddhamanasā maṃtrī rakṣārthamudyataḥ | tadā nairājanaṃ khyātaṃ sarvaśreyaskaraṃ paraṃ ||
sitādi yugabhedena vartate tu graho balī | śuklaḥ sarvapradaḥ khyāto rakte rājyavidhāyakaḥ ||
pītorakṣākaraḥ proktaḥ śatruvināśakṛt | caturyuge tu sarvatra pītakṛṣṇau dvitīyake ||
rājasarṣapagaurākhyo rūpau dvau tu hitau priye | yadā mṛtyuvaśāghrātassarvatai tu kṛṣṇapadrutaḥ ||
tadā tu ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ gokṣīrasitaśarkaraṃ | tilaivimiśritaṃ kṛtvā juhuyāt sarvaśāntidaṃ ||
tilaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ samāyuktaṃ rājasarṣapamuttamaṃ |
<36a>
tryakte vai juhuyāt samyak sarvaśānti pradaṃ śubhaṃ ||
anenaivābhimaṃtritvādyasya haste tu dīyate | saubhāgyamatulaṃ devi jayite(?) dyā(?)vasaṃśayaḥ ||
saptābhimaṃtritaṃ kṛtvā maṃtrenānena maṃtravit | mūrdhni pradāpayed yasya sarvadoṣaiḥ samucyate ||
abhimaṃtrya tathā dhūpaṃ puṣpaṃ vāsāṃsi vauṣadhaṃ | samālabhanapānaṃ vā bhojanaṃ vābhimaṃtritaṃ ||
dīyate(?) yasya tasyaiva na hiṃsaṃtitītihiṃsakāḥ | dividikṣu kṣiped yasya rakṣārthaṃ prayatātmanaḥ ||
divā vā yadi vā rātrau supte vā jāgratopi vā | avadhassarvabhūteṣu bhuvitiṣṭhatyasau naraḥ ||
rājarakṣāvidhānaṃ tu mayaivaṃ prakaṭī kṛtaṃ | tava snehāt praśastaṃ tu rahasyaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ ||
nṛpāṇāṃ nṛpapatnīnāṃ tatsutānāṃ dvijātiṣu | ācāryaḥ kurute yastu sarvānugrahakārakaḥ ||
maṃtrajñaḥ sādhako vātha sa pūjyassarvathā prabhuḥ | sammānaivamanairnityaṃ(?) dārairvividha vistaraiḥ ||
<36b>
yathā maṃtrārthasaṃyukta svāhā home phalapradaḥ | tathā sarveṣu kāryeṣu dīkṣito maṃtravitsadā ||
phalaprado bhavet samyak sarvaśakti pradaḥ śubhaḥ | sudhā yathā ca nāgānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca svadhā yathā ||
namaskārokti devānāṃ vauṣaṭ śāṃtau praśasyate | maṃtrajñānāṃ tathā nityaṃ(?) dānasanmānamuttamaṃ(?) ||
phalapradaṃ bhavatyāsu(?) sarvasiddhi pradāyakaṃ | jñānaśakti sthitā maṃtrāstaṃ jñānaṃ cetasi sthitaṃ ||
taccitaṃ pūjitaṃ tuṣṭaṃ sātvikaṃ bhavate sadā | satvasthā tu śṛyo nityaṃ lakṣmīstatra pravarddhate ||
rajastamo vināśena maṃtrāḥ satvodaye sadā | siddhi pradā bhavaṃtyāśu yatotīva sunirmalāḥ ||
<37a>
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena ājñaiṣā pārameśvarī | paripālyā prayatnena siddhimuktirna dūrataḥ ||
anuttara vidhānaṃ tu na dadyāt paradīkṣite | svaśiṣye dīkṣite dadyānnānyathā sarvathā priye ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyuṃjidamṛtīśavidhāne [paṃcadaśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || śrīdevyuvāca ||
kathitaṃ devadevena rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam | sarvāgama mayaṃ devaṃ ekavīraṃ mahābalaṃ ||
vāmadakṣiṇasiddhāntaṃ bhedatrayavibheditaṃ | vaiṣṇavādi samāyuktaṃ rahasyaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ ||
sarvadeva mayo hyeṣa mṛtyujid vyāpakaḥ śivaḥ | bahubhiḥ saṃpradādyaiśca yaṣṭavyo bhāva bhedataḥ ||
nānā kṛyopacāreṇa nānāsiddhi phalapradaṃ | adhunā śrotumicchāmi saṃyama hṛdi sthitaṃ ||
<37b>
tvadṛte saṃśayasyāsya cchettāna hyupapadyate | pṛthakpṛthaksamācāraṃ sarvaṃ devena bhāṣitaṃ ||
kathamasminsamācāraṃ sāmānyaṃ sarvatoditaṃ | kathamekena maṃtreṇa sarvesiddhyaṃti pūjitāḥ ||
bījaiḥ kūṭaistathā piṃḍairmālāmaṃtrairanekaśaḥ | vācyavācaka bhedena sarvasiddhiphalapradaṃ ||
kathamekena maṃtreṇa pūjanārho naro bhavet | bhavantīha surāḥ sarve svāvārasyaṃ prabhāvataḥ ||
mānavānāṃ hitārthāya kāruṇyāt parameśvara | kalimāsādya siddhyanti manujā duḥkhamohitāḥ ||
dāridryānalasaṃtaptā jarāmṛtyubhayānvitāḥ | pāyaikaniratāḥ krūrāstapassatya vivarjitāḥ ||
hiṃsā paiśunya cetaskā śaucācāra bahiṣkṛtāḥ | yoginī śākinībhiśca ḍādyoṃ ḍāmarikādibhiḥ ||
bhūtairyakṣairapasmārairmudritāḥ prāṇino yathā |
<38a>
siddhyaṃti vigatā yāsāstathā brūhi maheśvara |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
sādhu sādhu mahābhāge yathāpṛṣṭaṃ vadāmyahaṃ | bhaviṣyanti mahādevi kaliḥ kaṣṭataraṃ yataḥ ||
tadartheṃ paramārthena mayā te prakaṭī kṛtaṃ | paramātha paratvena mṛtyujitsarvato mukhaḥ ||
bhāvabhedena yaṣṭavyo mokṣasiddhiṃ samīhate | yasmin yasmin yadācāraṃ mayāśastreṣu bhāṣitaṃ ||
srotassutat tathā kāryaṃ viśeṣādyāga homayoḥ | anye sāmānyato devi na siddhyanti kadācana ||
kintasminnādhikārosti trividhe sarvasiddhide | dvaitādvaita vimiśre ca yaṣṭaṃ vai siddhido bhavet ||
yasmāt sarvagataṃ devaṃ viśvarūpo maṇiryathā | sādhakasyecchayā yaṣṭaṃ siddhidaṃ bhavate dhruvaṃ ||
yataḥ sarvagataṃ devaṃ sarvaṃśvantargataṃ vibhuṃ | tatsiddhi mukti dātāraṃ na varṇāḥ paramārthataḥ ||
<38b>
tasmāt sarvaṃ sadā devi yaṣṭavyaṃ bhāvabhedataḥ | yāgamasya pravakṣyāmi kṛyate tu yathecchayā ||
parvatāgre nadītīre gavāṃ goṣṭhetha catvare | vane copavane ramye deśakālānurūpataḥ ||
sarvaśalyavinirmukte duṣṭasatvavivarjite | puṇyadharme svasaṃvāse pāpācāra vahiṃ kṛte ||
yatra niṃdā parāḥ paurā na dṛśyanti kadācana | yatra paśyanti te duṣṭā saṃkīrṇaṃ sarvaśaṃkaraiḥ ||
tasmiṃ yajen mahāmaṃtraṃ gītibhiḥ parivarjitaṃ | gṛhe yāgaḥ prakartavyaḥ ācāryaistatva darśibhiḥ ||
suguptaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ viśeṣāṃ śāntikarmaṇi | dīkṣākāle tu kartavyaṃ maṃḍalaṃ yatra tatra hi ||
śāntau puṣṭau prayatnena suguptaṃ yajanaṃ dhruvaṃ | yasmādviṃsāparāloke dṛśyante siddhi hiṃsakāḥ ||
kīlanaṃ caiva maṃtrāṇāṃ bhedanaṃ mohanaṃ tathā | maṃtra saṃtāḍanaṃ caiva jaṃbhanaṃ staṃbhanaṃ tathā ||
ripu tvakaraṇaṃ cānyaṃ pratyaṃgairatvameva hi |
<39a>
sarvahāni karatvaṃ ca kṛyate duṣṭamaṃtribhiḥ | evaṃ daśaprakāreṇa prapataṃte hi hiṃsakāḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sugupte śaraṇopari | svagṛhe kārayedyannādyāgahomaṃ japaṃ tathā ||
atyaṃta phalaṃ śreṣṭha suguptaṃ mṛtyujitsadā | maṃḍale sthaṃḍile kuṃbhe nirviśaṃ na cetasā ||
harmyopari tathā homaṃ viśeṣācchānti puṣṭidaṃ | na vikalpotra deveśi vikalpādrauravaṃ brajet ||
yāgaṃ homaṃ ca tatraiva sarvasiddhiphalapradaṃ | taskarantaṃ vijānīyāt siddhi hāni karoti yaḥ ||
nādhikārī bhavet sopi tantre vai pārameśvare | sarvataḥ sa bhaved devi tatvaviccādhvavidguruṃ ||
evaṃ vyāptiṃ tu yo vetti parāparavibhāgaśaḥ | sabhavenmocakaḥ sākṣān śivaḥ paramakāraṇaḥ ||
śivatatvamavijñāya dīkṣādau kurute tu yaḥ | aṃdhenaiva yaṣṭāṃdhāśca ubhayośca bhrapātinaḥ ||
ātmānaṃ ca tathā śiṣyaṃ nītvā nirayasaṃkaṭe |
<39b>
tasmāt tatva vidaḥ śrīmānācāryaḥ sarvago bhavet | yāvanna tatva vicchreṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ karmāṇi kārayet ||
maṃtrajño brahmayogajño parasyaivātmano yathā | yāvanna nirmalo maṃtrastāvatsiddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet ||
nirmalaṃ tu bhaved devi tatsthā maṃtrāḥ sunirmalāḥ | tadudbhūtāstatsamāśca bhavante sarvasiddhidā ||
śivaśakti niyogācca maṃtrāṇāmudayaṃ śubhaṃ | sarvatra phaladā maṃtrā yataste ca śivāsmṛtāḥ ||
tasmāt śiva mayāḥ sarve nityānugrahakāriṇaḥ | śivaścācārya rūpeṇa tena te phaladā smṛtāḥ ||
yāvanna tatva vinmaṃtrī guruṃ vā sādhako pi vā | tāvanna phalado devi satyametadbravīmite ||
anyathā bhogasaṃyuktaṃ ācāryaphaladaṃ na hi | tasmāt tatva vidaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvadā sarvakarmasu ||
tena yo dīkṣito jaṃturbrahmahāpi śivo bhavet | yatra yatra sthito deśe yaścaivaṃ tu vidhiṃ yajet ||
<40a>
yena yenopacāreṇa bhavabhedena yena vā | sāmānyena viśeṣeṇa kaulikenātha suvrate ||
tattatsādhayate śīghraṃ yadi devaḥ sadāśivaḥ | caturaśre vartule tu hastamātredhikethavā ||
ācāryasyecchayā sarvaṃ sidhyanti vyāpti vedanāṃ | kriyāśaktisvarūpeṇa kauṃḍilyā vyāpti bhedanā ||
tat kuṃḍaṃ vyāpakaṃ jñātvā sarvadastu bhaved guruḥ | yāvanna viṃdate vyāpti kuṃḍasyaivātmano pi ca ||
sādhyaścaiva paśuścaiva pāṣānāṃ ca ṣaḍadhvavit | bālavat krīḍate tāvat kāryaṃ tasya kathaṃ bhavet ||
yaḥ punarvetti cātmānaṃ śivaśakti svarūpakaṃ | sasarvaphaladaśreṣṭhaḥ sakartā sarvagaḥ śivaḥ ||
jñānaśaktimayo vahni vyāpyavyāpaka bhedataḥ | sajātā sarvakartā ca mokṣadaḥ phalado guruḥ ||
ṣaḍadhvātītayāgaṃ tu yajate yastu daiśikaḥ | māyodadhau śanodbhūtaṃ sarvatrāṇakaraḥ śivaḥ ||
<40b>
adhvamadhyagataṃ yogaṃ yaḥ karotyavicārataḥ | nāsau mocayituṃ śaktaḥ parasyaivātmano pi vā ||
naiva siddhiṃ tu labhate na kārya karaṇe kṣamaḥ | ṣaḍadhvādhvānato naiva baṃdhanaṃ tu malaṃ smṛtaṃ ||
māyīyāṇava karmotra visare baṃdhakāraṇaṃ | paśuścaiva na tatrasthaṃ śaktau vai mocane guruḥ ||
adhvamadhyagatāḥ pāśā prarohaṃti sadātmanaḥ | tadātītaṃ paraṃ jñātvā kona mucyeta baṃdhanāt ||
kopi vā mokṣado na syāt kassiddhiṃ labhate sadā | kona dātā bhaven maṃtrī kaḥ kāryena kṣamaḥ pṛye ||
sa paraḥ sarvato bhadra taṃ jñātvā tanmayo bhavet | mānonmāna pramānena viṃdate yo dhvaned guruḥ ||
śilpivad bhavate dakṣo vicitrākārakārakaḥ | na mokṣadastu bhavate nasau siddhiphalapradaḥ ||
tasmāt śiva samāssarve draṣṭavyā tatvavedibhiḥ |
<41a>
kārmī jñānī tathā yogī ācāryastrividha smṛtaḥ | karmayogau tu sa deveśi jñāne yogaphalapradaḥ ||
pṛthagbhedena dṛśyeta jñānā dve yoga karmaṇā | tasmādārya mukhye tu jñānavāṃ sarvado bhavet ||
śivāśrayaḥ śivasthastu śivaśakti pracoditaḥ | nirmametajagatsarvaṃ śivarūpo yatasthitaḥ ||
icchājñānakriyā yuktaḥ śivatatva viśāradaḥ | yaḥ karoti śivecchā tu jñānavyāpya vyavasthitaḥ ||
acintyā maṃtraśaktirvai parameśa mukhodbhavā | yavyatprakurute jñānī śivaśakti samāśrayāt ||
tattanniṣpadyate tasya śivaśaktiprabhāvataḥ | tasyaiva sammukhā maṃtrā dṛṣṭapratyayakārikā ||
śāntikādīni karmāṇi viṣabhūtagrahādiṣu | kṣaṇena kurute sarvaṃ śivaḥ paramakāraṇaḥ ||
taṃ prabodhayate yastu jñānayoga balānvitaḥ | maṃtraśakti prabhāvena sa dīkṣāṃ dīkṣayet pṛye ||
<41b>
kṣayannayatyaśau pāśāṃ dadyādevaṃ paraṃ padaṃ | yojanādyojayet śaktiḥ śivaśakti prabhāvataḥ ||
tasyaiva sanmukhā maṃtrā dṛṣṭapratyayakārakāḥ | śāntikādīni karmāṇi viṣabhūtagrahādiṣu ||
pratyayastasya bhavate dṛṣṭaṃ nānyasya kasyacit | gāruḍe bhūtataṃtre ca vāmasrote ca dakṣiṇe ||
jyeṣṭhe caṃḍāsi dhāre ca pratyakṣaphaladā kriyā | atyaṃtamalinasyāsya puṃso baddhasya māyayā ||
karmaṇā bhogasaktasya abhilāṣānvitasya ca | mokṣaṃ dadāti dīkṣāsau kriyājñānasvarūpiṇī ||
tanmanā tu parāśakti jñānarūpāvadhūtikā | sā kṛyetyabhidhīyeta na kriyāvādhvamadhyagā ||
yogaśaktirjñānaśaktiḥ sarvaśāstreṣu gīyate | sā śaktiḥ parameśasya śivasyā śivahāriṇī ||
baṃdhamokṣakarī puṃsāṃ na svataṃtrā svabhāvataḥ | anenaivā tu mānena śivaḥ sarvapradaḥ śubhaḥ ||
<42a>
śivādi gurupaṃktiryā rudrakoṭyo hyanekaśaḥ | āptopadeśamārgeṇa pāraṃparyeṇasaṃsthitā ||
śivajñānaṃ yato devi sarvai cāptāgamasmṛtaḥ(?) | brahmādistaṃ ca paryantaṃ śivaśakti samanvitaṃ ||
evaṃ śakti mayaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamaṃ | śaktimānsarvakarmāṇi kurutenātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
śāntikādīni karmāṇi karmāṇyevānyathā na hi | śaktihīnā na siddhyante yugakoṭiśatairapi ||
japakoṭisahasraistu homalakṣaiḥ suvistaraiḥ | tasmātsarvaprayatnena śivajñānaṃ samabhyaset ||
tadāsiddhyanti karmāṇi sarvāṇyetānyathā na hi | śāntikādīni karmāṇi kurutesau tadā guruḥ ||
yāge home jape caiva tathā lekhya krameṇa tu | āpadāyadivotpanā yathoktaṃ yāgamārabhet ||
sādhyanāmena tadrvayaṃ saṃbhāreṇa tu saṃbhṛtaḥ | yāgaṃ tu kurute yasya tasya śāntiḥ prajāyate ||
<42b>
tilakṣīraghṛtenaiva sitaśarkarayā saha | homayedyasya nāmena mahāśāntimavāpnuyāt ||
kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhistu kṣīrāktaiḥ susamāhitaḥ | homayedyasya nāmena tasya śāntirbhavedhruvaṃ ||
sumanāghṛtasaṃyuktā homayedyasya nāmataḥ | tasya śāntirbhavet kṣipraṃ nātrakāryavicāraṇā ||
śrīkāmaiḥ śrīphalaṃ hutvā śriyāmāpnoti puṣkalāṃ | ghṛtaguggūluhomena puṣṭirbhavati śāśvatī ||
mṛtyujitsaṃpuṭaṃ kṛtvā sādhyanāmaṃ japed yadi | ātmano vā parasyāpi mṛtyustasya na bādhate ||
aṣṭapatre tu kamale karṇikāyāṃ niveśayet | sādhyarṇarodhitaṃ nāma tatordhvaṃ mṛtyujid bhavet ||
āgneyādi vibhāgena taleṣṭhaṃgāni vinyaset | dviraṣṭadalasaṃpūrṇaṃ bāhye tatkamalaṃ likhet ||
svaraśoḍaśakenaiva pūrvādau pūrayet tadā | dvātṛṃśadalasaṃyuktaṃ tadbāhye paṃkajaṃ nyaset ||
<43a>
kādisānta (*) meṇaiva pūrvādīśānagaṃ kramāt | sādhyarṇa rohitāḥ sarve varṇāścakra traye sthitāḥ ||
sarveṣāmadhyataḥ saṃjñā sādhyasyaiva tu rodhayet | jīvamadhyagataṃ nāmakarṇikāyāṃ niveśayet ||
prāṇānte kalpaye jīvaṃ prāṇavarṇāntamadhyagaṃ | bāhye tu maṃḍalasaumyaṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ prakalpayet ||
tadbāhye tu puraṃ caiṃdraṃ vajradṛgvajrabheditaṃ | bhūrjapatre tu saṃlikhya cakrametadvarānane ||
suśukle nirvraṇeślākṣṇa rocanā kuṃkumena vā | malayakṣīrayuktena karpūrakṣodadhūsaraṃ ||
saṃveṣṭyasitasūtreṇa karpāsena navena ca | madhumadhye nidhāpyevaṃ sugaṃdhaghṛtamiśritaiḥ ||
mṛdbhāṃḍe sannidhāpyeva sitapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet | pāyasairghṛtamiśraiśca bhakṣairnānāvidhaistathā ||
mṛṣṭairdhūpaipayitvā pūjayedbhūtisaṃbhṛtaiḥ | bāhye tu kalaśā naṣṭau pūrvādau pūjayet tataḥ ||
sitacaṃdanakarpūrasudhūpodasaṃsrutā |
<43b>
ratnagarbhāṃbusaṃpūrṇāṃ sarvauṣadhisamanvitāṃ | sauvarṇāṃ rājatāṃ tāmrāṃ mṛnmayāṃ vā suśobhanāṃ ||
akālamūlāṃ suśubhāṃ prasastāṃ lakṣaṇānvitaṃ | saṃpūjya teṣāṃ madhye tu lokapālā krameṇa tu ||
teṣāṃ śivājñādā tathā rakṣadhvaṃsādhyamuttamaṃ | prātarmadhyāhne sāyāhne niśārddhe pūjayet tataḥ ||
saptarātre vyatikrānte mṛtyujidbhavate naraḥ | sarvavyādhivinirmuktaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ ||
sarvarogairvimucyeta jvaraiḥ sarvairna saṃśayaḥ | sarvaduḥkhaparityaktaḥ ītibhiḥ parivarjitaḥ ||
tiṣṭhate ca narobhūmau kaṃcuyukto yathāphaṇiḥ | yadi nānyamano devi sādhakastatparāyaṇaḥ ||
japahomarataḥ śāntaḥ asmin sthāne tu tiṣṭhati | satvavāṃdhairya saṃpanno dayādākṣiṇyasaṃyutaḥ ||
saptarātre vyatikrānte mṛtaścaivānayedvalāt | gobhūhiraṇyavastrāṇi keyūrakaṭakādibhiḥ ||
<44a>
pūjyosau parayā bhaktyā śāntipuṣṭirviśeṣataḥ | yasmāt maṃtramayaḥ sovai śivaḥ sākṣāṃ tu daiśikaḥ ||
tena pūjitamātreṇa sarve maṃtrāḥ phalapradāḥ | bhavatyavitathaṃ bhadre satyametannasaṃśayaḥ ||
anyathā siddhihāniḥ syāt kṛtaṃ caiva nirarthakaṃ | ācāryaścaiva sādhyasya kṛtyā(?) cotpadyate bhṛśaṃ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena maṃtravit pūjayed guruḥ | bhavanti pūjitā maṃtrā sarvasiddhiphalapradāḥ ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [vyāptyādhikāraḥ ṣoḍaśamaḥ] || bhagavānuvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi cakrarājaṃ mahābalaṃ | pūrvavat madhyato nāma jīvāntaṃ kalpayet pṛye ||
prāṇānte tu tataḥ kṛtvā varṇāntāṃtarvyavasthitaṃ | aṃtimaṃ tu tato bāhye tadbāhye madhyamanyaset ||
prathamā tu tato bāhye karṇikāyāṃ tato nyaset | kesareṣu svarāḥ yojyā daleṣvaṃgā pūjayet ||
<44b>
bāhye tu kalaśaṃ lekhyaṃ kalaśo bhayamadhyagaṃ | pūjayet pūrvavidhinā japahomārcane rataḥ ||
sādhayatya cireṇaiva ciṃtitaṃ nātrasaṃśayaḥ | sarvaśāntipradaṃ cakraṃ puṣṭisaubhāgyadāyakaṃ ||
āyurvīryapradaṃ puṇyaṃ jvararogavināśanaṃ | pararāṣṭravibhītānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vijayāvahaṃ ||
rājastrīṇāṃ sutānāṃ ca viprādīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | rakṣā hyeṣā prayoktavyā sarvopadravanāśanī ||
paṃḍtyā(?)caiva likhennāma akṣarāntaritaṃ priye | ādyaṃ tu mūlamaṃtraṃ tu vauṣaḍ jāti yuta nyaset ||
pūrvavat pūjayed bhūri pāśe caiva site śubhe | tatkṣaṇān mucyate rogairāghrāto yadi mṛtyunā ||
vauṣaḍ jāti yutaṃ maṃtraṃ dikṣvaṣṭau sulikhesite | bhūrjavalkalake ramye madhye nāmaṃ tu pūrvavat ||
rakṣāpadasamāyuktaṃ tadbāhye śaśimaṃḍale | maṃtrāntaṃ varṇamamṛtaṃ kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyutaṃ ||
tāḍirmaṃḍalamāpūrya bāhye tu kamalaṃ nyaset |
<45a>
tadbāhye caṃdrasūrye tu puraṃdarapure sthitau | rocanā kuṃkumenaiva kṣīraśarkarayā likhet ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena pūrvavaṃśāntyatasthitaḥ | rājaraktā tu vai proktā sarvopadravanāśanī ||
rājarakṣāvidhānaṃ tu homaye kṣīrasaṃyutaṃ | sitaśarkarasaṃyuktam sugaṃdhaghṛtasaṃyutam ||
kṣīravṛkṣeṃdhane vahnau tilaiḥ śāntirbhaveddhruvaṃ | yadāsau mṛtyunā prātaṃ kālena kalitā narāḥ ||
yaṣṭvā tu pūrvavad yāgaṃ maṃḍalaṃ tu yathoditaṃ | kartavyaṃ dravyasaṃbhāraiḥ saṃbhṛto mṛtyunāśanaḥ ||
mṛtyuruntarate śīghraṃ maṃtrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | tadeva bhūrjapatre tu sitaśarkarayā saha ||
kṣīreṇa rocanā yuktaṃ kuṃkumena cyutaṃ likhet | rukmakuṃbhe tu madhvākte sthāpayet tu sugopitaṃ ||
tadūrdhve tu dvitīyaṃ tu kṣīrapūrṇasuśobhanaṃ | sravantamamṛtaṃ dhyātvā sthāpayet puṣṭi kāmataḥ ||
<45b>
saptarātraprayogena mṛtyujid bhavate naraḥ | kṣīṇakāyo bhavet pūrṇaṃ pakṣānte tu yathā śaśī ||
na mṛtyuvaśagaḥ saurai satyaṃ menāṃnṛtaṃvacaḥ | sādhyarṇarodhitaṃ nāma rakṣāpadasamanvitaṃ ||
madhye saṃyojayet sādhyaṃ pūrvavaccāmṛtīkṛtaṃ | tadātmānaṃ tu saṃveṣṭya vāruṇena tu vai punaḥ ||
kalāśeṣeṇa tadbāhye saṃpūrṇena tu veṣṭayet | puraṃdaraṃ tato bāhye dvācaturdikṣu gocare ||
tanmaṃḍalāṃte yojyeta vaktrasaṃpuṭamadhyagaṃ | rakṣitaṃ cāmṛtīśena na tasya bhayadaṃ kvacit ||
bhavati yoginī bhūtarakṣarākṣasahiṃsakaiḥ | brahmarākṣasakāḥ sarve ḍāvyoḍāmarikāstathā ||
teṣāṃ vai rakṣaṇārthaṃ tu yāgarakṣāsuśobhane | kuṃbhāntasthaṃ likhennāma taṃ sthāpya kamalopari ||
adhomukhaṃ tato puṣṭikamalaṃ pūrvavallikhet | tatkarṇikasthaṃ vimalaṃ adhovaktraṃ prayogataḥ ||
sravamānaṃ tato dhyāyedamṛtaṃ sarvato mukhaṃ |
<46a>
amṛtīśaṃkaraṃ dhenu praviṣṭaṃ tu vibhāvayet | hṛdisthaṃ tatpraviṣṭaṃ tu sarvanāḍyaḥ prapūrayet ||
tatkṣaṇād bhavate puṣṭi kṣīṇakāyaśca yo naraḥ | paṃktyā tu vai likhen maṃtraṃ pratyekaṃ varṇamadhyagaṃ ||
nāmaṃ sādhyasya vai lekhyaṃ digvidiṅmṛtyujillikhet | pūrvavat kamalaṃ likhya ṣaḍaṃgaṃ pūrvavat priye ||
saṃyojya pūjayet śaktyā yathāvibhavavistaraṃ | sarvaśvetopacāreṇa sarvaduḥkhanivarhaṇaṃ ||
bhavate maṃtramukhyaistu nātrakāryavicāraṇā |
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [yaṃtrādhikāro nāma saptadaśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || śrīdevyuvāca ||
bhagavaṃ devadeveśa sarvasatvaṃ hiterata | vrātāstvaṃ tu sureśāna sarvānugrahakāraka ||
uktaṃ tvayā maheśāna vyāpti maṃtreṣu cādhvanaḥ | ākhyā hi me jagannātha yadi tuṣṭosite prabhuḥ ||
<46b>
maṃtrāṇāṃ kīlanādau tu yojanaṃ sūcitaṃ prabhuṃ | nākhyātaṃ devadeveśa yathāyojyanti sādhakāḥ ||
cūrṇalopāṃjanādīni kuhikāni tu yāni hi | yathā maṃtrastathā japyai dhyānadhāraṇayorapi ||
anyena muktadoṣestu viṣādigarasaṃbhave | yojitaṃ maṃtrarājānaṃ kathaṃ jñāsyanti daiśikāḥ ||
paradehe svadehe vā lakṣaṇaiḥ kaiści dṛśyate | dṛsaṃhiti kutaḥ kāryaṃ rakṣāyā parameśvara ||
īśvara uvāca ||
yo viṃdyāt samidaṃ jñānaṃ sarvakṛt sādhakottamaḥ | paraprayuktamaṃtrasya lakṣaṇaṃ surasuṃdari ||
rāgadveṣābhibhūtaṃ tu apimānaśca yoginaḥ | kāryārthaṃ rājakārye vā paribhūtaṃ yatastataḥ ||
yojayet maṃtrarājānaṃ yena yat savibhāssadā | sevite maṃtranāthena trailokyaṃ hastagaṃ bhavet ||
kiṃ punarmānuṣe loke vaśyākarṣaṇamāraṇaṃ | karoti līlayā pūrvaṃ maṃtrarājaprabhāvataḥ ||
<47a>
dhyānena maṃtrayuktena tathā lekhya krameṇa ca | homena lohacūrṇaiśca tathā saṃkramaṇauṣadhaiḥ ||
vivādigava(?) doṣaiśca khānapāna vilepanaiḥ | ekānte nirjane rātrau niḥśabde tu vanepi vā ||
pūjayed devadeveśaṃ mahābhairava rūpiṇaṃ | mahāsaṃhārasaṃyuktaṃ naivedyairvividhaistathā ||
pānaiśca vividhaiścaiva dhūpadīpānulepanaiḥ | vasyāgratasthito maṃtrī dhyāyed bhairava rūpiṇaṃ ||
mahākarālavadanaṃ daṃṣṭrānaṃ vikṛtānanaṃ | urdhvadṛṣṭi virūpākṣiṃ mahāśmaśru bhyānakaṃ ||
āyudhairvividhaiścaiva nānāpraharaṇodyataṃ | grasamānaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ kālarūpe svarūpataḥ ||
dhyānayuktaṃ mahāmaṃtraṃ yojadyedvṛddhi(?) madhyataḥ | mahāmaṃtravaraṃghoraṃ varṇarūpaṃ vicintayet ||
bhramamānaṃ dehamadhye akṣarāmaṃtranāyake | drūtāste hemavat tatra vahnirūpa viciṃtayet ||
bhramamānaṃ dehamadhye akṣarāmaṃtranāyake |
<47b>
drutāste hemavat tatra vahnirūpaṃ vicintayet | tāmravadrasarūpaṃ tu hṛdisthā parikalpayet ||
susvarūpaṃ bhavet tatra tatrāntaḥ kāraṇaṃ kṣipet | śaktirmāyādhikāsteṣā ekabhāvaṃ vikalpayet ||
vījāṃkuravaśekaṃ tu mahānaṃdaṃ pravartayet | anantāśakti saṃkṣobhā ca(?) kureva(?) samutthitā ||
prajvalantaṃ tṛśūlaṃ tu dhyāyamānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ | niṣkrāntaṃ kanikābhāsaṃ sphurajvālā balāyutaṃ ||
suvaktra yaṃtramārgeṇa preritaṃ śakti vegataḥ | savyasya vaktraraṃdhreṇa praviśantaṃ vicintayet ||
dīptahāṭakavarṇābhaṃ vahnijvālāsamāyutaṃ | sphurantaṃ vāyuvegena dhyāyamānaṃ mahābalaṃ ||
cittaśaktyā tu deveśi mṛtyurūpeṇa coditaḥ | tataḥ saṃkṣobhitaṃ śūlaṃ patitaṃ hṛdimadhyagaḥ ||
tenākrāntastu maṃtreṇa tīvraṃ hṛtpadmamadhyagaḥ | āyudhaiḥ pretasatyasya nānāpraharaṇodyataiḥ ||
<48a>
iti dhyāyenmahākrūrāt patitosau mamāgrataḥ | śūlena saṃpuṭī bhūtaṃ gṛhītaṃ paricintayet ||
caitanyaṃ grāhayet tatra sādhya hṛnmadhyasaṃsthitaṃ | svaśaktyoccārayedvegāddhyānaṃ maṃtraprayogataḥ ||
nīyate samamāsīdhye maṃtrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | śarīraviṃvaśī bhūta nānāmaṃtraprayogataḥ ||
iti dhyānaparo yastu saptāhānmārayetasaḥ | mṛyate nātrasaṃdeho yadi sākṣāt puraṃdaraḥ ||
saptarātra prayogena devināstyatrasaṃśayaḥ | athavāmaraṇaṃ necchet praviśetasvavaktrataḥ ||
sādhyacintaṃ samādhyāya satato hyadhimadhyataḥ | sādhyāmṛta mahoghe siṃcamānaṃ hṛdisthitaḥ ||
anenaiva prayogena ākarṣe tṛdaśānvalān | saṃhṛtaḥ sarvavīraiśca kā kathā manujeṣu ca ||
svarājyaṃ svadhanaṃ caiva svadārāt svasutaṃ tathā | dadaṃti maṃtriṇe sarvaṃ ākṛśyā maṃtra tejasā ||
<48b>
ṛpūṃdāsatvamāyānti klinna yonyastathāṃbu yā | pūrvavat saṃprayoktavyaṃ triśūlaṃ sādhyavigrahe ||
tatrasthaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ cālpamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | svasthānāt plāvyate vegānnītaḥ kalpānta vāyunā ||
uccāṭayati tatsādhyaṃ meru madhyādi saṃsthitaḥ | anenaiva prayogena prīti vidveṣalakṣaṇaṃ ||
niṣkrāntaṃ tadvidhā cintya ubhau teṣāṃ prapūjayet | uccāraṇa prayogena vimuktā yānti vegataḥ ||
vidveṣe dahanaṃ lakṣmī kiṃ punarmanujā bhuvi | evamevānva yogena praviṣṭaḥ sādhyavigrahe ||
tatrasthaṃ devadeveśaṃ ciccetanasamanvitaṃ | ākramya hṛdayaṃ tiṣṭhet pibe dravya gamaṃ kramāt ||
drāvayet paradehaṃ tu sūryavadvisamanvitaṃ | pratyekaṃ drāvayed dravyaṃ pūrayitvā svavigrahaṃ ||
āpūrya dehaṃ sakalaṃ caṃdravat tiṣṭhate tataḥ | kṣīṇaṃ sādhyaṃ viciṃtyaṃ ca sarvakṣīṇaṃ svavigrahaṃ ||
<49a>
kiṃcitkāle tu tiṣṭheta yāvat pūrvaṃ nirantaraṃ | vegenāgacchate pūrṇaṃ praviśat sa hṛdāntare ||
amṛtāt plavyamātmānaṃ deveśaṃ tatra pūjayet | tairdravyairamṛtī bhūtaṃ paripūrṇaṃ prakalpayet ||
saptāhābhyāsayogena ānayennirvikalpataḥ | brahmaviṣkeśvarādyaistu rakṣitaṃ yadi nityaśaḥ ||
anenaiva prayogena hṛdi cintaṃ kariṣyati | unmattaḥ kriyate vāpi staṃbhitaṃ vā prakalpayet ||
mūko vā tiṣṭhate sāgrya grāhayed vā yadicchayā | jvarabhūtaviśādibhyo vyādhiśokabhayāvahaṃ ||
śūlamunmeladuḥkhaiśca nānāvyādhiśatairapi | yādṛśaṃ cecchate sādhyaṃ tādṛśaṃ kṛyate balā ||
anenaiva prayogena sādhyaṃ vā grāhayed viṣaiḥ | nāgaiśca dasyubhissādhyai saptāhānnātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
tataḥ prabhṛti sādhyasya duḥkhaśokāśca jāyate | anutsāhaṃ tato dvegaṃ baṃdhuputrakṣayānvitaḥ ||
<49b>
dārāṃbhṛtyāṃstathā bhrātṝṃ prajā sarvaṃ ca yauvanaṃ | nocyate kramaśassādhyo duḥsvapnaṃ paśyate sadā ||
atikleśa saho neha(?) vacinto bhavate kvacit | anucchāhamanāścāso bhavatrāsaṃ ca jihmakaṃ ||
kāryahāniṃ rājabhayaṃ videśagamanaṃ tathā | duḥkhitaṃ rājyabhraṃśaṃ vā deśādeśa paribhramaṃ ||
evamādi sahasraiśca duḥkhadoṣaiḥ samanvitaṃ | tiṣṭhate ca paro bhūmau vyabhicāre kṛte sati ||
athavā homayet sādhyaṃ phalaṃ dravyaṃ tathauṣadhaṃ | khadirāgnau kaṃṭakaiśca cityagnau vāpi homayet ||
kāryā tu sārahomairvā tuṣāṃgārasamanvitaiḥ | puṣpakaṃ kaṇakairvāpi mahāphalguṣameva vā ||
kṛṣṇāṃjasaṃbhavaṃ kāryaṃ homasiddhyānusārataḥ | tadadbhāvāt prakurvīta phalaiḥ sadyaistṛkaṃṭakaiḥ ||
raktāstu kusumānvaśye uccāṭe kṛṣṇavarṇakaṃ |
<50a>
maraṇe kaṃṭakairyuktā vidveṣe gaṃdhadūṣitā | uccāṭe kaṭu tailoktā ākarṣe ghṛtasaṃyutāṃ ||
kā kasya saṃyutaṃ kṛtvā māraṇe kusumaṃ hunet | vidveṣe kaṭu tailaiśca lavaṇena hutau yajet ||
evameva phalaṃ hutvā bījāṃśca vividhā kramāt | karoti vividhaṃ cchidraṃ sādhako duṣṭahiṃsakāt ||
athavā lekhayedvāpi nānāmaṃtraprayogataḥ | maṃtranāthena deveśi sādhyanāmaṃ vidarbhitaṃ ||
analāṃ kāyethecchāsau sādhyārṇeṣu niyojayet | āgneyyaṃ maṃḍalāṃtasthaṃ vāyumaṃḍalaveṣṭitaṃ ||
jvalaṃtaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ dinānāṃ saptakaṃ yadi | tatkṣaṇānāṃ jāyate dāghaṃ yadi śakrasamo bhavet ||
maṃtrarājaṃ nivadvyetasmareṇa paṭamadhyagaṃ | śmaśānāṃgārake likhya viṣaraktānvitena tu ||
yasya nāmaṃ varārohe hūṃ phaṭkāraṃ vidarbhitaṃ | mārayet tatkṣaṇāvegāt karajātisamanvitaṃ ||
<50b>
mṛyate saptarātreṇa atha śatru bhayaṃ bhavet | maṃtranātha mahādevi adhordha prāk svasaṃsthitaṃ ||
sādhyanāmadeveśi kāryatvaṃ śapade likhet | vigataṃ śreyamāpnoti mānuśrīyasya yā bhavet ||
tṛrakṣamavamāne tu yannāmaṃ tu samālikhet | yakārādyaṃta saṃruddhaṃmataḥ phaṭ stritayānvitaṃ ||
preta sthāne nidhāpyevaṃ bhairavaṃ tatra pūjayet | arkapuṣpairvarārohe taddiśābhimukhasthitaḥ ||
tamuccāṭayate kṣipraṃ vidveśo bhava jāyate | niyoga bhavade hyeṣa mātāmitro yadi bhīvan ||
paṃcāgena piśācasya kruddharājavasānakaṃ | nāmnā samālikhed yasya unmattaṃ jvaradāgha kṛt ||
kākolūkasya pakṣāṇi kharoṣṭraṃ mūtramṛttikā | kṛtvā patikṛtaṃ kāryaṃ kākaraktena lekhayet ||
kākolūkasya pakṣāṇi gudayātā vinikṣipet |
<51a>
catuṣpathe nikhane śmaśānāgniṃ tatopari | prajvālya homayet prājñaḥ kākapakṣāṃśca suvrate ||
udbhrāntapatrasahitā kharamūtreṇa bhāvitā | yasya nāmaṃ samuddiśya yakārādyaṃ tu rodhitaṃ ||
maṃtrāvasāne vinyasyastaṃ visargāntaṃ vicārayet | bhramate kākavat pṛthvī śatruvyādhi prapīḍitaṃ ||
piṣṭyākaṃ niṃbapatrāṇi mṛtakeśa tuṣāni ca | śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ kuryādarkapuṣpaistu veṣṭayet ||
śmaśāne nikhane tatra vahneḥ prajvālya copari | puṣpairvibhītatarujairyasya nāmnā tu homayet ||
vidveṣo bhavate śatruḥ kāmadeva samopi yaḥ | atha cenmārayet kṣipraṃ śatru vai niścitātmanaḥ ||
apakāraśatairyuktau kṛtaghno duṣṭa cetasaḥ | kapāla dvitayaṃ grāhyaṃ nāmaṃ śatro samālikhet ||
kapālahastakastatra viṣāṃgāreṇa bhāvitaḥ | rudhireṇa samāyuktaṃ phaṭkārāṃta vidarbhitaḥ ||
<51b>
mahāpitṛvanaṃ gatvā bhairavaṃ pūjayet tataḥ | kṛṣṇamālyopahāraistu tataḥ karmasamārabhet ||
vijñaptaṃ devadeveśa śatrumevaṃ nipātayet | anujñātastu deveśiṃ gṛhītvā tu śiro dvayaṃ ||
tatra gatvā mahādevi kapālāsanasaṃsthitaḥ | tatrastho rūpavarṇastu dakṣiṇābhimukha sthitaḥ ||
ātmānaṃ bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ dhyātvā ghoraṃ svabhīṣaṇaṃ | krūddhaḥ samuccaren maṃtraṃ vilomena mahāmatiḥ ||
hūṃ phaṭ svamuccārya kādyaścāsphālayedbhṛśaṃ | khaṃḍaśa (**?) to yāvat tāvacchatruḥ pranaśyate ||
saptarātreṇa deveśi prayogastva nivartakaḥ | anye śatasahasrāṇi anyakālocchitāni tu ||
prayogāni karotyeśaḥ pūjito maṃtranāyakaṃ | sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ caiva yogajaṃ śaṃkayāpi vā ||
kṛttrimaṃ vā prakurvīta saccintaṃ prāṇahānikaṃ | mūtraṃ raktaṃ tathā keśaṃ valāsthiṃ vānasīṣu ca ||
<52a>
gosthiṣyāsthibhṛgālāṃsthi tathā meṣāvilocanaṃ | godhūma hāṭake yukto gṛdhravṛṣṭyā ca lepayet ||
bhakṣaipānai pradātavyā yāgaṃ kṛtvā supūjitaṃ | snāne vilepane dhūpe gaṃdhavastre tathauṣadhe ||
mṛyate nātrasaṃdehaṃ tṛsaptena samo yadi | vanakāmāṣamudgāṇi apānena vinirgatā ||
dhānyaṃ śṛtaṃ tathā raktaṃ strīraktaṃ nirmalaṃ tathā | mūlaṃ raktaṃ tathā keśaṃ lālā caiva varānane ||
mūtraṃ jārīkṛtāhvāvanāgeṃdramadasaṃyutā | mohanī viṣṇukrāntā ca dhātrī caivakatasthitā ||
puṣyarikṣe tu yuṃjīta garvitānāṃ yaśasvini | bhakṣepāneṣu dātavyaṃ yāvadāyurvaśī bhavet ||
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ prayuktaṃ maṃtranāyakaṃ | karoti vividhā vādhāṃ pūrvasevā yadā kṛtā ||
sādhako yojayed devi maṃtrā maṃtreṣu jāyate | khādakāstrādi maṃtrāṇāṃ paraspara niyojanāt ||
tīvrātīvrābhiyogena dūrṇitāniḥkhaṣā gatā |
<52b>
parasparaṃ siddhihāni japasya haraṇaṃ tathā ||
jaṃbhanaṃ staṃbhanaṃ caiva mohanaṃ kīlanaṃ tathā | balābalaviyogena sādhakāye yajaṃti ca ||
ityamṛtīṣavidhāne [vaśyākarṣaṇādhikāroṣṭā daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ || śrīdevyuvāca] ||
bhagavaṃ devadeveśa sarvabhūta hiterata | (*?) ṇaṃ kṛtvā sureśāna sarvānugrahakāraka ||
uktānvayā mahādeva vyāptimaṃtreṇa cādhvanaḥ | ākhyāhitaṃ jagannātha yadi tuṣṭosi me prabho ||
