maṃtrāṇāṃ kāla(?) nādau tu yojanaṃ sūcitaṃ vibhuḥ | nākhyātaṃ devadeveśa yathā siddhyanti sādhaka ||
parayuktā naśyanti kṛtyā khārkhodakāni ca | pratyaṃgirā prayogena haṃtiriṣṭānyanekaśaḥ ||
yathā tathā mahādeva brūhi niḥsaṃśayaṃ mama |
īśvara uvāca ||
vādināmeva sarveṣā maṃtravādaṃ tu cottamaṃ | ājñā niyojayet maṃtraṃ maṃtraliṃgāni suvrate ||
<53a>
dīpanaṃ bodhanaṃ caiva tāḍanaṃ cābhiṣecanaṃ | vimalīkaraṇaṃ caiva tatheṃdhana niveśanaṃ ||
santarpaṇaṃ guptibhāvaṃ āpyāyaṃ navamaṃ tathā | evaṃ navaprakāreṇa maṃtravādamaśeṣataḥ ||
yojānāti sa jānāti maṃtrasādhanasādhanaṃ | ekādaśaṃ vidho maṃtro jñātavyo hi punaḥ pṛye ||
yena samyak prayogāśca siddhyante sādhakeśvarāḥ | te ca vai saṃpravakṣyāmi sarvaśāstreṣu sammataṃ ||
saṃpuṭaṃ grathitagrastaṃ samastaṃ ca vidarbhitaṃ | ākrānvamathamādyantagarbhasthaṃ sarvatoddhṛtaṃ ||
tathā yukti vidarbhaṃ ca vidarbha grathitaṃ tathā | ityekādaśadhā maṃtrā bhavanti phaladā pṛye ||
siddhaṃ sāddhyasusiddhaṃ ca tathaivāritvameva ca | jñātvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa maṃtra vā (***?) caret ||
udayāstamanaṃ vyāptiṃ dhyānamudrā svarūpataḥ | yo vetyevamavedajño sarvakṛt sarvakottamaḥ ||
evamādyairaśeṣaiśca bhāvabhedaḥ sureśvari | bhāvitavyā(?) mahāmaṃtrā bhavanti phaladā priye ||
<53b>
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena jñātvā sarvaṃ niyojayet | asya vai maṃtrarājasya nāsti devi vicāraṇā ||
sarveṣāmeva maṃtrāṇāṃ vṛṃhakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | anena graṃthitā maṃtrāḥ sūtremaṇi gaṇā iva ||
asya garbhe sthitā maṃtrāḥ bhavanti siddhimokṣadāḥ | yasmāt sarvagataṃ devaṃ sarvasiddhiphalodayaṃ ||
vyāpakaṃ sarvato bhadraṃ sarvato sukhamavyayaṃ | pūraṇaṃ sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ paramaṃ balaṃ ||
maṃtrāṇāṃ yoni bhūtaṃ tu mokṣadaṃ siddhidaṃ śubhaṃ | yatastatosya maṃtrasya nāsti devi vicāraṇā ||
ebhirdoṣa sahasraiśca chidritaṃ sādhakaṃ yadi | vināyakaiśca ye grastā ādhivyādhi prapīḍitāḥ ||
rājyabhraṣṭāstu rājānaḥ pararāṣṭranipīḍitāḥ | viraktapaurānnirvṛtyā aputrāśca suduḥkhitāḥ ||
mṛtaputrāmṛtādārā sa bhayāvigata śṛyaḥ | ācāryaḥ sādhako vāpi maṃtrasiddhi parāṃmukhā ||
viprutrā durbhagānāryo baṃdhyā vidviṣṭabhartṛkāṃ ||
<54a>
evamādi sahasraiśca duḥkhadoṣaiśca saṃyutā | dṛṣṭvānta mānavāṃ loke uktaurdoṣaiśca dūṣitāḥ ||
tathā caivagra kartavyaṃ yāgabhāgyaruhāṃparāṃ | śrīvāgaṃ parameśāni maṃtreṇānena maṃtriṇā ||
mahālakṣmī kṛte yāge bhāgyabhāgbhavate naraḥ | pūrvokta doṣanirmukto prāpnoti paramasukhaṃ ||
kalaśe nābhiṣiktosau pūjayitvā mahāśriyāṃ | prāpnoti cintitāṃ kāmān brahmaviṣṇuśivopamān ||
evaṃ jñātvā tu medhāvī yāgaṃ kuryāt suśobhanaṃ | kartavyaṃ sarvathā devi sarvaśreyakaraṃ paraṃ ||
pūrvoktenūpradeśe tu sarvalakṣaṇalakṣite | sarvaśalyodvṛti(?) ramye mahāpadmavane tathā ||
prachanneṣu ca śasteṣu sugupte śaraṇopari | ālikhe maṃḍalaṃ tatra caturaśraṃ samantataḥ ||
ekona viṃśasūtrāṇi patayed vaiṃdra vāruṇe | tathā dakṣa kuberābhyāṃ(?) sūtrāṇi susamāṃ kuru ||
<54b>
bhāgeṣṭādaśabhirbhāgaiścaturdikṣu samantataḥ | koṣṭhakānāṃ śatātrīṇi caturviṃśādhikāni tu ||
tanmadhye tu likhet padmaṃ aṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanaṃ | bhāgāṣṭakaṃ tu tanmadhye caturthā vibhajet tataḥ ||
prathame karṇikā kāryā kesarāṇi dvitīyake | saṃdhayaśca tṛtīye tu dalāyāṇi caturthakaṃ ||
bhrāmayeccaturau vṛttā susamāsusamānataḥ | dikṣusutrāṣṭakaṃ dadyād vidikṣuḥ pātayet tathā ||
aiṃdryā diśi gṛhītvā tu madhyasūtrapramāṇataḥ | kiṃ jalkasthaṃbhavetpatraṃ tanmadhye karṇikā likhet ||
dalasaṃdhi sthiteḥ sūtre sthāpyapārśve tu bhrāmayet | dvābhyāmubhayapāśvābhyāṃ purvapatraprasādhayet ||
itarānyevamevaṃ tu padmapatradalaṃ bhavet | pītā tu karṇikā kāryā puṣkarā haritā smṛtā ||
kesarāṇi vicitrāṇi caturviṃśakasaṃkhyayā | sitāraktā tathā pītā mūlamadhyāgra yojitā ||
<55a>
suśvetāśca dalākāyāṃ vyomarekhā tu vartulā | bāhye cāṃguṣṭhamānena śvetavarṇāsuśobhanā ||
dalāntarāṇi raktāni tadbāhye caturaśrakaṃ | tathaivāṃgulamānena sitarekhā tu pītalā ||
gātrakāni tato bāhye bhāgābhyāṃ caiva pārśvataḥ | sitādi varṇabhedena koṇeṣṭhāgneyamādibhiḥ ||
gātrakāḥ pītavarṇādyāḥ pūrvādi kramamālikhet | dvau dvau bhāgau tato lopya vītyarye caiva sarvataḥ ||
kṛṣṇena rajasā pūrya śaṃkhapadmavibhūṣitāḥ | dvāraśuklādi kurvīta dvibhāgenaiva pārśvataḥ ||
vīthimānena vistāraṃ vīthyardhena tu kārayet | kaṃṭhaṃ tathopakaṃṭhaṃ ca tathā śobhopaśobhitaṃ ||
evaṃ niṣpādyate dvāraṃ saṃvṛttā trīṇi kārayet | paścimaṃ vivṛtaṃ kāryaṃ pārśvābhyāṃ vilekhayet ||
śobhāścaivopaśobhāśca raktavarṇāśca pītakāḥ | pratikuryāccaturdikṣu koṣṭakairadharottaraiḥ ||
<55b>
koṇānteṣu likhed devi padmaśaṃkhau samaṃ tataḥ | tasmin bāhye samantāccu(?) bhūtarekhā prapātayet ||
sitādi varṇabhedena nivṛttyādyāśca tāḥ kalāḥ | bāhye tu pattravalyabjaiḥ svastikairupaśobhitaṃ ||
ālikhet maṃḍalaṃ mukhyaṃ tanmadhye tu yajecchṛyaṃ | pūrvādhivāsaḥ kartavyo yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ ||
yāgaharmyaṃ prakartavyaṃ śaktyādravyānusārataḥ | vedītoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ nānā dhvajavibhūṣitaṃ ||
chatrapādukaśayādi nānā śobhasamanvitaṃ | gṛhopaskaraṇādyaiśca bhogairnānāvidhaistathā ||
vitānoparikartavyaṃ suśvetaṃ tu manoramaṃ | javanī caturaṃgā ca dīpāṣṭau dikṣudāpayet ||
bālavyaṃjanaghaṃṭāśca tathā darśa catuṣṭayaṃ | patākāṣṭau tavāśreṣṭhā nānāraṃgasamudbhavāḥ ||
kalaśāṣṭau tathāropyā tāmrāyā mṛnmayāpi vā | samudrāṣṭau tathā pūjyā sarvauṣadhi samanvitāḥ ||
bhūtapallavayuktāśca sa hiraṇyāśca pūjayet |
<56a>
kāṃḍāṣṭau paṃcaraṃgāśca caturdikṣu niveśayet | lokapālāstathā pūjyā paṭeṣu svākṛti sthitāḥ ||
tathā hyastrā kṛtiḥ kāryā daśadikṣusamantataḥ | dvārādhyakṣāṃstato bāhye kartavyāmnāya darśanaṃ ||
sarvasādhāranatvāśca paṭe kāryāstu yā dṛśā | vedamaṃgalanirghoṣairjayapuṇyāhasaṃyutai ||
nṛttavāditragītaiśca stotrairnānāvidhaistathā | ācāryaśca sruśucirdakṣaścaṃdanāgurucarcitaḥ ||
dhautapautikayā yuktaṃ uṣṇīṣāṃguli bhūṣitaḥ | kaṭakādibhihāraiśca puṣpaṃ sragdāmabhūṣitaḥ ||
mūrtipairdhūpabāhaiśca arghavāhaistathaiva ca | sarvasaṃbhārasaṃyuktaṃ adhivāsanapūrvakaṃ ||
kuṃbhostravarddhanī caiva tathā kṣetraparigrahaṃ | paścādvairajapātaṃ tu kartavyaṃ daiśikena tu ||
pūrvokta vapuṣā dhyātvā mṛtyujit madhyato yajet | tadutsaṃge sthitāṃ devīṃ śriyaṃ vai viśvamātaraṃ ||
<56b>
viśuddhasphaṭikaprakhyāhimakuṃdeṃdu saprabhāṃ | caṃdrārbudapratīkāśaṃ gokṣīra sadṛśaṃ prabhāṃ ||
muktāphalanibhāṃ śvetāṃ śvetavastrāvibhūṣitāṃ | sitacaṃdanaliptāṃgīṃ karpūrakṣodadhūsarāṃ ||
śubhrahāreṃdu kāṃtādi ratnojvalavimaṃḍitāṃ | sitasragdāmamālābhiḥ kamalaiḥ suvibhūṣitāṃ ||
harahāsasuśubhrāṃgī siṃhahāsāṃmanauramāṃ | suśuklamukuṭopetāṃ ekavaktrāṃ trilocanaṃ ||
baddhapadmāsanāsīnāṃ yogapaṭṭavibhūṣitāṃ | śaṃkhapadmakarāṃ saumyāṃ varadābhayapāṇinīṃ ||
caturbhujāṃ mahādevīṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāṃ | dhyātavyāṃ bhāvabhedena rūpāyudhavibhūṣitāṃ ||
amṛtīśavidhānena tathaivāṃgāni vikalpayet | sarvaśvetopacāreṇa pūjayet sarvasiddhidāṃ ||
anenaiva vidhānena śrīdharaṃ vā śṛyā saha | pūjayed bhaktito devi sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ ||
<57a>
pādyārghakusumaiḥ śubhrairmṛṣṭadhūpaiśca dhūpayet | lehaiḥ peyaistathā voṣpairbhakṣairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
pūjayet parameśānaṃ sarvasiddhiphalapradaṃ | pūrvaivanirmitaṃ kuṃḍe homaṃ pūrvoditena ca ||
tarpaye devadeveśīṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā | athavāṣṭa bhujāṃ devīṃ citāṃ ratnakarāṃ śubhāṃ ||
kalaśaṃ dhārayennityaṃ amṛtena samanvitaṃ | somasūryakarāṃ devīṃ sitapadmoparisthitaṃ ||
nidhīnāṃ copariṣṭā tu gajamaṃgalabhūṣitāṃ | brahmādyaiḥ surasaṃghātaiḥ pūjitāṃ saṃstutāṃ sadā ||
dhyātāṃ japtāṃ maheśāni siddhimuktiphalapradāṃ | yaṣṭvā tu devadeveśīṃ kuṃbhasthāṃ prapūjayet ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena yāge pūrvodite śubhe | pūrvavaddhyānayogena kuṃbhamadhyagatāṃ yajet ||
japtvā cāṣṭottaraśataṃ tvabhiṣiṃcetapūrvavat | tasyā balā mahālakṣmī rājyaṃ vāyadabhīpsitāṃ ||
<57b>
bhaumāṃtarikṣasiddhīni divyāṃ caiveśvarī śubhāṃ | īhitaṃ kāmayet kiṃcit suprasanno prayacchati ||
āyurbalaṃ yaśaḥ kīrti medhākāṃti śṛyaṃ vapuḥ | sarvaṃ vivarddhate yasya yasya veśmani pūjitā ||
yaḥ kaścidabhiṣikto vā yasya vā sādhayet priye | pūrvoktaṃ sarvamāpnoti śāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ sukhāni ca ||
paṭe tu likhitāṃ devīṃ yasya veśmani pūjyate | pūrvoktena vidhānena tasya sarvaṃ prayacchati ||
bahunātra kimuktena siṃhasyaiva yathāmṛgāḥ | prapalāyanti sarve duṣṭādoṣāṃ sahasraśaḥ ||
kimanyairmaṃtrabṛṃdaiśca devatārādhanena vā | yatraiṣā devadeveśī dhyātā japtā tu pūjitā ||
saṃgrāmakāle dhyātavyā khaḍgapatralatā sthitā | jayaṃ prayacchate vaśyaṃ ripudarpāpahā bhavet ||
saṃgrāmāgre sadāyojyā ripudarpāpahā bhavet | avaśyaṃ jayamāpnoti devadevyā prasādataḥ ||
<58a>
api vyādhiśatārto vā duḥkhaśokaiḥ prapīḍitāḥ | sarvavyādhivilipto vā kṛtyā khārkhodapīḍitāḥ ||
maṃtrairyaṃtraistathā dhyānairjapahomaviśādikaiḥ | cūrṇalepāṃjanādīni kuhakāni tu yāni vai ||
kariṣyanti ripo yatra striyau vā puruṣopi vā | pūjitānena vidhinā teṣāṃ pratyaṃgirā bhavet ||
āśritya paramāṃ devīṃ bhaktyāsaṃpūjayet tu yaḥ | yathā na dṛśyate duṣṭaiḥ pāpācāra ratairnaraiḥ ||
maṃtrasiddhaistathā dhūrtaiḥ samayaghnaiśca kaṃṭakaiḥ | tathā guptānuyaṣṭavyā gopitā siddhidā bhavet ||
yāgā home tathā japye mudrāyāṃ dhyānayogataḥ | suguptāṃ dhyāyate devī yasya saubhāgya bhāgbhavet ||
yasmāduṣṭāśca vahavo jighāṃsanti sukhāni ca | anya saubhāgya saṃtyaktā daurbhāgyena prapīḍitāḥ ||
paśyanti yāge home ca japadhyānavidhau sadā |
<58b>
janayanti mahāvighnāṃ tasmādgupta tamo vidhiḥ | bhāvabhedena yaṣṭavyā sādhakena vipaścitā ||
ekavīrakrameṇātha pūjitā vā sureśvarī | dadāti sarvakāmāṃśca prasannāparameśvarī ||
śaive vaiṣṇavasiddhānte bhedenaiva supūjitā | bhaktānāṃ cittabhedena phaladā parameśvarī ||
cintāmaṇiryathā loke cintitārthaphalapradā | tathaiṣānumahālakṣmī sarvakāmaphalapradā ||
devāsuramanuṣyāśca nāgāgaṃdharvakinnarāḥ | ṛṣayopsara sā yakṣā rākṣasāśca piśācakāḥ ||
bhūtavetālayoginyo mātaro guhyakāstathā | ḍāvyoḍāmarikā devyo bhaginyo dūtayastathā ||
tatrāyogeśvarāḥ sarve yogasiddhāśca sarvaśaḥ | mahāśriyā prasādā ca sarve siddhāśca siddhidaḥ ||
ākāraṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ mahālakṣmī mahābalā | āśṛtānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ sādhakānāṃ varapradā ||
<59a>
asyāḥ parā hi jagato nānyā kīcit sukhapradā | aṇimādi guṇā ye ca sarvajñā dyāstu ye parā ||
te sarvesyāḥ pumāṃ devi sidhyante nānyathā pṛye | mokṣārthī vā prakatha(?) ekavīrāṃ tu pūrvavat ||
athavā śaktisaṃyuktaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayate vibhuṃ | sarvasaṃbhārasaṃyuktaṃ prāsāde tu manorame ||
śaktiśaktimato yogāt sthāpayitvā vidhānataḥ | janmāntara sahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitaṃ ||
tatkṣaṇānna paśyate devi tūlarāśi rivānalat | veṣṭamātreṇa deveśaḥ sthāpito vāpi dīkṣitaḥ ||
kulāṃ coddharate sarvāṃ daśapūrvāṃ daśāparān | yāvat prāsāda liṃgaṃ vā pratimā citrabhittayaḥ ||
pāṣāṇadhātavaścaiva dhvajo vā dhvajayaṣṭayaḥ | samudrā sarito yāva merucaṃdrārka bhūmayaḥ ||
saṃkhyā tatparamāṇūnāṃ tāvatkālaṃ bhunakti saḥ | bhogāt sadāśive tatve bhuktvānirvāṇamāpnuyāt ||
<59b>
yathā samudrasaṃprāpya siṃdhuḥ samarasī gataḥ | tathā śivatvamāpannaḥ paśurmukto bhavārṇavāt ||
pratiṣṭhāphalametaddhi prāpnuyānnātrasaṃśayaḥ | adīkṣitānāṃ nṛpatau tatsutānāṃ dvijātiṣu ||
bhogālasyāthavā devi karmadoṣāśca vighnataḥ | na yaṣṭaṃ napastaptaṃ na dhyānaṃ na pratiṣṭhitaṃ ||
pātityena mṛtānāṃ tu yeṣāṃ narakasaṃsthitiḥ | nidānairvahubhirdevi bālastrīvṛddhamānuṣaiḥ ||
mṛtasyoddharaṇārthāya dīkṣārthaṃ parameśvaraṃ | yaṣṭavyaṃ pūrvadeveśaṃ viśeṣastatra vā kṛtiḥ ||
kartavyā rajatāvaśyaṃ sadṛśādvādaśāṃgulā | kāryā vā gopaye devi kuśairvā snānaśodhitā ||
dīkṣaiva tatra saṃskārāṃ vyāptyā yatra samaṃ nayet | aṇuṃ ca yojayet tasmiṃ pūrṇāhutyā kṣipe nale ||
yojanyā śivatatve tu tataḥ sā yojyatāṃ labhet | śrāddhe saṃpūjayed devaṃ maṃteṣṭi tveti vā yajet ||
<60a>
pratiṣṭhāpyastathā devi dagdhapiṃḍe śmaśānake | pūrvokta dravyasaṃbhāraiḥ pūrvoktavidhinā guruḥ ||
pūrvoktaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ śaktidvayasamanvitaṃ | catuścāṣṭauthavā devi pūrvadhyānāvalokitaṃ ||
pūrvoktaṃ phalamāpnoti ityājñā pārameśvarī ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre [mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāno ekona viṃśatimaḥ paṭalaḥ] || śrīdevyuvāca ||
kathitaṃ devadevena prāṇināṃ hitakāmayā | amṛteśavidhānaṃ tu sarvarakṣākaraṃ paraṃ ||
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi saṃśayaṃ me hṛdisthitaṃ | dṛṣṭipātaṃ prakurvanti jaṃtūnāṃ mātaraḥ sadā ||
asaṃkhyātāstutā devyo aprameya balānvitāḥ | chāyācchidreṇa bādhyante yoginyau balavattarāḥ ||
atyanta valinastīvrā nistṛṃśānirbhayā dṛḍhāḥ | hiṃsakāḥ sarvajaṃnūnāṃ cālānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
<60b>
na saṃkhyā vidyate tāsāṃ tatropāyaṃ vadasva me | chāyārūpaṃ phalaṃ yattadṛṣṭipātachalaṃ tathā ||
prakurvanti sadā deva cchāyāstāstu kati smṛtāḥ | dṛṣṭipātabhayaṃ kiṃ vā kathaṃ vāpi nivartate ||
etatsarvaṃ samāsena prasādādvadaśūladhṛk |
bhagavānuvāca ||
śrūyatāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi chāyāyāścaiva lakṣaṇaṃ | aprameyā hyanantāśca mātaro balavattarāḥ ||
bhūtāśca vividhākārā hyanantāśca mahābalāḥ | yakṣarakṣapiśācāṃśca ye cānye hiṃsakā śaṭhāḥ ||
na saṃkhyā vidyate teṣāṃ koṭi bhedena saṃsthitāḥ | saṃkṣepataḥ pravakṣyāmi yena mucyanti bālakāḥ ||
stṛyaśca manujā vāpi nṛpapanyaśca tatsutāḥ | yathātyajanti balino yāgavrataparāyaṇāḥ ||
maṃtrasannaddha dehāśca suprameya balānvitāḥ | purākalpe samutpannā nānājasahasraśaḥ ||
<61a>
sarvatra hiṃsakāḥ krūrāḥ sarvakālajighāṃsakāḥ | yāgārthamudyatāḥ sarve bhairavānucarāḥ sadā ||
tacchaktyā balinaḥ sarve tattejo balabṛṃhitāḥ | mahāpaśūpahāreṇa toṣayanti mahāvratāḥ ||
mahābhairavarūpaṃ yatsvacchaṃdaṃ kṛtavāhanaṃ | daityānāṃ tu vadhārthāya devānāṃ sthāpanāya ca ||
iṃdrādayo yadā devā sadādityairupadrutāḥ | vidrāvitā yadā daityai tadāhaṃsaṃstutaḥ suraiḥ ||
brahmādyairvividhaistotrai māyā teṣāṃ hitārthataḥ | mahābhairavarūpaṃ tu svacchaṃdaṃ tu kṛtaṃ mayā ||
vidrāvaṇaṃ tu daityānāṃ devānāṃ sthāpanāya ca | tadarthaṃnugrahā bhūtā mātaro nirmitā mayā ||
jitvātaiḥ śatrudarpaṃ kṛtārthāste madaṃtikaṃ | āgatāḥ prārthayantisma vināśabhayabhīravaḥ ||
bhagavaṃ devadeveśa asmābhistoṣito hyasi | tuṣṭena devadevena yatkāryaṃ tatprasādataḥ ||
kuru deveti coktaṃ taistadā te caritā mayā |
<61b>
ajeyā varadānena prārthayanto mahābalāḥ | evaṃ bhavanti me sarve yathāsṛṣṭā mayāpurā ||
tataḥ prabhṛti taiḥ sarva jagatsthāvarajaṃgamaṃ | ākramyapīḍitaṃ sarvaṃ devamānuṣa tiryagaṃ ||
devānāṃ tu jighāṃsanti bhūtāḥ svarge mahābalāḥ | mānuṣānyeva valino jighāṃsanti samantataḥ ||
tiryagyonyaśca vividhā jighāṃsanti tathāparāṃ | asaṃkhyātāstu te proktā aprameya valotkaṭāḥ ||
punaḥstutohaṃ devaiśca prajāpati puraṃdaraiḥ | tadākṣiptā mayāsarve bhūtāśca balavattarāḥ ||
mātaro bhīmarūpāśca bhayabhītāmadantikaṃ | ājñāvidhāyinaḥ sarve kiṃkurvāṇāt samāgatān ||
tadā kruddhena deveśi maṃtrakoṭyo hyanekaśaḥ | avatārya vināśārthaṃ mātṝṇāṃ ca gṛheṣu ca ||
śivaśakti prabhāvena mananatrāṇadharmiṇaḥ |
<62a>
maṃtrakādyā hyanantāśca mayā sarvedhikārikāḥ | vidyābalabhayādbhītā āgatāste madaṃtikaṃ ||
tadā mayā te vikṣiptāḥ sthaleṣu ca jaleṣu ca | digaṃtareṣu śūnyeṣu mamājñāvaśavartinaḥ ||
balikāmāstathā cānye bhoktukāmāḥ pare tathā | ratikāmāhaṃ tu kāmā vātajāścāpi pittajā ||
śleṣmajāḥ sannipātānye bhūtā vividharūpakāḥ | mayoktāstepi balino mayādāvaśavartinaḥ ||
maduktamaṃtramudrābhi dhyānaiśca vividhairyutān | paṃcasroto vinirbhinnaṃ śṛṇvanto hi padāṃ pṛye ||
tadā sarve vidravanti bhayabhītādiśodaśa | nidhānai bahubhissarvaijighāṃsaṃti naraṃ paśuṃ ||
durācāraṃ durātmānaṃ aśuciṃ puruṣādhamaṃ | mātāpitro rasaṃ mānā tathāyanavarjanāt ||
ati strī saṃgaśamanā nibaṃdhāśca viśeṣataḥ | akālamaithunānmohād bhayāt saṃbhramaṇaṃ tathā ||
<62b>
saṃdhyāvivarjitā ye ca saṃdhyāmaithuna sevakāḥ | bhojanā dhyayane nidrā saṃdhyāyāṃ yoni sevakāṃ ||
akāminīḥ kāmayanti gurudārādi ye pṛye | pradhvaṃsayanti balino balā caivāti yoṣitaḥ ||
tathānye satya vaktāraḥ prabhudrohakṛto śubhāḥ | anuktaiḥ pāparacitai ye narā samyamādhavāḥ ||
etairanyairnidānaiśca gṛhyante mānuṣā grahaiḥ | strīṇāṃ caiva tu dauḥśīlyādaśaucā bhakṣyabhakṣaṇāt ||
tathobhayagurudveṣādbhartāravyabhicārataḥ | anyairanukta doṣaiśca dūṣitā mudrayaṃti ca ||
ruṃdaṃtāṃ caiva bālānāṃ rātrau jāgaraṇāṃ tathā | rātrau saṃtrāsanā caiva duṣṭacchāyāsudūṣitā ||
rajasvalā dūtikāśca pāpiṣṭhā hyaśucistadā | unmattā vidrutābhītāstrastādoṣaiśca dūṣitāḥ ||
rudaṃtī krośamānāśca muktakeśāstadā ruṇā |
<63a>
duṣṭapukkasacaṃḍāla sparśenaiva tu dūṣitāḥ | śavasparśāntargamanā tatrastha sparśanāt tathā ||
tadduṣṭasāhacaryācca tadvārtānugamaṃ tathā | aśaucādi tathānekai asparśairapi dūṣaṇāt ||
duṣṭā strī puruṣo vātha snātvāṃ cchāyāṃ pradāpayet | bālānāṃ bhūpatīnāṃ ca tatpatnīṃnāṃ tapasvināṃ ||
cchāyācchidreṇa bhūtāśca mātaro balavattarā | dṛṣṭipātaṃ prakurvanti ladhvacchidrāśca hiṃsakāḥ ||
raudrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ pātayanti bālānāṃ ca jighāṃsakāḥ | pāpiṣṭhāśca durācārā bhūtadyastā jvarādikaiḥ ||
tatonmattā duṣṭacetā pāpācārāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ | bubhukṣitāa matsarāśca śatravo vairagarvitāḥ ||
etāścānyāśca bahavo dṛṣṭiṃ saṃpātabhīṣaṇāṃ | paśyanti yadi bālānāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
dṛṣṭipātaṃ tato jāye jñātvā śreyasamācaret | tatkṣaṇānna vilaṃveta svalpe naiva kṛtena hi ||
<63b>
na bādhayaṃte doṣāni uṣitvā vādha yantitāḥ | na vilaṃvya tadā kālaṃ savya eva samācaret ||
sa vauṣadhaissupraśastairbahubhirmaṃgalānvitaiḥ | paṃcagavyena vā tatra maṃtrayuktena kārayet ||
snānaṃ saubhāgya jananaṃ sarvadoṣa bhayāpahaṃ | ācāryo maṃtrakalaśai pūrvavadvicoditai ||
sadāti sadyo bālānāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | sadyaḥ śreyaskaraṃ puṇyaṃ puṣṭidaṃ kāṃtidaṃ śubhaṃ ||
yadā hyanantāstatrasthā mātaraḥ saṃnidhāḥ pṛye | jighāṃsanti tadā sadyo mahāmātrīṣu pūjayet ||
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā | vārāhī ca tatheṃdrāṇī cāmuṃḍā saptamātaraḥ ||
etāstu mātarāḥ sapta pūjayitvā śivaṃ bhavet | samastamātṛcakrasya yonayastāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
tābhiḥ pūjitamātrābhirupahāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ | kṛtsnaṃ mātṛ samuhaṃ tu tuṣṭo bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||
<64a> pradhānāḥ sarvamātṝṇāṃ etāḥ sapta prakīrtitāḥ | sitapītaraktakṛṣṇaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhaistathā ||
pāyasaiḥ kṛsarairmātsyarlehyaiḥ repairaśeṣataḥ | caturvidhena māṃsena ghasmarairbalibhistathā ||
pūjayitvā tu mālānāṃ sadyaḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati | tasmāt pradānayāgena guṇabhūtāstu devatāḥ ||
triptā bhavanti sarvatra sarvaśreyo hyavāpnuyāt | triṃśatkoṭisahasrāṇi svāṃguṣṭhā nirmitā mayā ||
vināyakānāṃ ghorāṇāṃmagnijvalita cetasāṃ | yaditairvighnitaḥ kaścidabhibhūto bhave naraḥ ||
tatrādhidaivataṃ pūjyaṃ vighneśaṃ tu vināyakaṃ | anya taṃtropacāreṇa dhyānayogena pūjayet ||
hemaṃ ratnāni dhārūni bījānyeva pradāpayet | svena svenaiva rūpeṇa sarvaṃ sarveṣu dāpayet ||
vighnaiḥ pramucyate sādhyaṃ tatkṣaṇānnātrasaṃśayaḥ |
<64b>
yadi bhūtairgahairghorairmudritāṃ balinairnaraṃ | tadā bhūteśvaraṃ yojyaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ ||
rākṣasaiḥ vividhairyatra prāṇino vādhitā dhruvaṃ | iṣṭvā rakṣodhipastatra sarvaśreyamavāpnuyāt ||
yadā yakṣairasaṃkhyātairati bhūtaṃ kvacinnaraṃ | tadā vai śravaṇaṃ śīghraṃ yaṣṭvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||
aṣṭayonyastathā divyau viruddhā yadi kutracit | tadā tu bhairavaṃ yāgaṃ kuryācchreyamavāpnuyāt ||
antarbalistu sarveṣāṃ dātavyo bhūri ghasmaraṃ | tadā bāhyabaliṃ kṣetre dātavyaḥ śreyamicchatāḥ ||
āraṇyako baliścānyaṃ mahiśādyaistathājinaiḥ | vividhaiśca baliṃ kuryāt sarveṣāṃ tu pradāpayet ||
nadītaṭe śmaśāne vā aṭavyāṃ mātṛmaṃḍale | prātarmadhyāhnakāle ca sāyaṃ caivārddha rātrataḥ ||
balisteṣu pradātavyāstena tṛptā bhavanti te | udakaṃ hyannamiśraṃ tu bhūriteṣāṃ pradāpayet ||
yena tṛptāstu te sarve sarvaśreya phalapradāḥ |
<65a>
bhavantya vitathaṃ bhadre mātṛvat pālayanti te | smṛtirmedhā jayaṃ vṛddhi vapurāyuryaśaḥ sukhaṃ ||
naṣṭaṃ balaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ dadatyena bali smṛtaḥ | evaṃ mṛtyujitā sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ ||
skaṃdagrahāgṛhītānāṃ bālānāṃ pīḍitātmanāṃ | rati grahaistathā nāryorabhibhūtā bhavet kvacit ||
kārtikeyaṃ tato yaṣṭvā pūrvokta vidhinā dhruvaṃ | kṣipraṃ tā ca pramucyanti skaṃdādyā ye śiśu grahāḥ ||
yasmin kuleyaṃ daśe tu mudritaṃ kīlitaṃ kvacit | tatkule naiva yaṣṭeta sarvadoṣairvimucyate ||
tadarddhaṃ tu mayā sarvaṃ rahasya prakaṭīkṛtaṃ | asmintaṃtre tu sarveṣāṃ amṛteśa vidhānataḥ ||
sarvataṃ mlaṣu sāmānyaṃ mṛtyujit prakaṭīkṛtaṃ | sarveṣāṃ hṛdayaṃ guptamaprakāśyaṃ mahādbhutaṃ ||
na kena cidahaṃ pṛṣṭo nākhyātaṃ kasya cinmayā | rahasyaṃ saṃpradāyaṃ ca sarvaśreyaḥ sukhāvahaṃ ||
sādhakasya prayatnā ye bhaktyā hyārādhayanti ca |
<65b>
sarvaduḥkhairvimuktāste satyaṃ menānṛtaṃ vacaḥ | anenaivātmanaḥ kāryaṃ sarvaduḥkhanivarhaṇaṃ ||
bhaktānāṃ svasutānāṃ ca svadārāṇāṃ tu kārayet | svaśiṣyāṇāṃ tu bhaktānāṃ nānyathā tu prayojayet ||
sarvāśramaṃ gurutvācca bhūpatīnāṃ ca sarvadā | tatsūtānāṃ ca patnīnāṃ kartavyaṃ tu hitārthinā ||
nitye naimittike kāmye śāṃtyarthe kārayet sadā | mukhe prakṣālite nityaṃ tilakaṃ śveta caṃdanaṃ ||
saptābhimaṃtritaṃ kāryaṃ doṣanivṛttayet tadā | snānakāle tathā kāryaṃ tilakaṃ śvetabhasmanā ||
smālabhana puṣpaṃ vā tāṃbūlaṃ vābhimaṃtritaṃ | dīyate yasya tasyeha na hiṃsaṃtīha hiṃsakāḥ ||
bhojanaṃ cābhimaṃtraiva maṃtreṇānena maṃtravit | ubhayoścaṃdrayormadhye bhuṃjāno mṛtamaśnute ||
sarvavyādhivinirmuktastiṣṭhate nṛpatiḥ kṣitau | atha krīḍanakāleṣu gajāśca mahiṣeṣu ca ||
astra krīḍāsu sarvāsu rakṣārthaṃ kalaśaṃ yajet |
<66a>
krīḍārthaṃ vijayārthaṃ tu rakṣārthaṃ hiṃsakādiṣu | yasmādduṣṭāśca vahavo jighāṃsanti nṛpeṣu ca ||
tasmādrakṣā prayoktavyā sarvaśreyaskarī śubhā | tataḥ suptasya nṛpaternidrā kalaśamarcayet ||
raupyamauṣadhi saṃyuktaṃ caṃdanāgurucarcitaṃ | kṣīraścodaka pūrṇaṃ vā yajet mṛtyujitaṃ japet ||
sarvaśvetopacāreṇa puṣpadhūpārghapāyasaiḥ | graṃthe sthitāṃ mahānidrāṃ jagatsaṃmohakārakī ||
sukhārthaṃ nṛpate rātrau jīrṇārthaṃ bhojanādike | ārabdhā devadevena ājñādanteti bhāvayet ||
tato rātri samagrā tu tiṣṭhate nidrayā saha | yakṣa rakṣaḥ piśācādyā dusvapne mātarāsu ca ||
bhayaiḥ saṃtrāsaduḥkhaiśca muktastiṣṭhedyathā sukhaṃ | lokapāleṣu cāstreṣu rakṣārthaṃ nṛpateṣvapi ||
pūjanaṃ cārgha puṣpādyaiḥ kalaśe pūjite sati | yasyaivaṃ satataṃ kuryājjñānavāṃ daiśikottamaḥ ||
<66b>
pūrvoktaṃ sarvamāpnoti ityāha bhagavāṃ śivaḥ | nimitteṣu ca sarveṣu amṛteśaṃ yajet sadā ||
kāmarūpī yajed yasmāt sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt | prajānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya śālīnāṃ sasyasaṃpade ||
sutapatnīṣu rakṣārthaṃ ātmano rāṣṭravṛddhaye | iṃdrarūpī yajet tasmād bijayārthaṃ nṛpeṣu ca ||
gobhūbrāhmaṇarakṣārthamātmanaḥ svajaneṣu ca | mahānavamyāṃ pūjyeta bhūri yāgena veśmani ||
pūrvokta śreyamāpnoti āyurārogyasaṃpadaḥ | astrayāgaṃ prayatnena kartavyaṃ siddhihetutaḥ ||
astrasiddhimavāpnoti prayuktā phalamaśnute | yadā mṛtyuvaśā prātaḥkālena kalitaṃ nṛpaṃ ||
ariṣṭacihnitādāna deśaṃ vā tatsutādayaḥ | brāhmaṇādiṣu sarveṣu paurajānapadeṣu ca ||
śālicūrṇādi śasyeṣu phalamūlodakena ca | durbhikṣavyādhikādyeṣu utpātaiścāpyanuttamaiḥ ||
<67a>
tadā nairājanaṃ kāryaṃ rājñāṃ rāṣṭrasya vṛddhaye | pūrvavadyajanaṃ kṛtvā kalaśenābhiṣiṃcayet ||
niḥśaṃkaṃ nirjane rātrau śubhametat tu daiśikaḥ | jaya puṇyāha śabdena vedamaṃgalasvastikaiḥ ||
abhiṣiṃcata rājāna siddhārthān homayed bahūn | nairājanavidhānena nāmāṃkaṃ juhuyāt pṛye ||
vahnau saṃkruddhamanaso ajaṃśca prokṣayedbahūn | tṛptyarthaṃ bhūtasaṃghasya maṃtrīrakṣārthamudyataḥ ||
śākunoṃtpāśagatyā vā vijñāya śakunaṃ hitaṃ | yajeṃdra śivavāruṇyāṃ niryātaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ ||
atha pūrvoktena vidhinā gṛhayāgaṃ tu kārayet | yāvat saptāhnikaṃ devi bhūrihomena siddhidaṃ ||
tasyācalā mahālakṣmīrājyaṃ vā yadabhīpsitaṃ | bhaumāṃtarikṣasiddhīni prāpnuyā nṛpatiḥ sukhī ||
tadā nairājanaṃ khyātaṃ sarvaśreyaskaraṃ paraṃ | pūrvoktaṃ na paśyate doṣaṃ devināstyatrasaṃśayaḥ ||
goṣu madhye yajed yasmā sadāvarddhati gokulaṃ |
<67b>
siṃdūraṃ gaurikaṃ vāpi abhimaṃtreta maṃtravit | yoktavyaṃ goṣurakṣārthaṃ śṛṃgordhve sarvadoṣajit ||
aśvānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya pūrvoktavidhinā yajet | abhimaṃtreta kalaśaṃ śirasteṣāṃ pradāpayet ||
siddhārthakāṃ japitvā tu kaṃṭhe kāryaṃ tu murddhani | sarvadoṣavinirmuktāṃ gajāṃścaiva tu rakṣayet ||
ajeṣu paśavo hyevaṃ rakṣāsarvatra kārayet | sarvaprāṇiṣu rakṣārthaṃ yoktavyaṃ nṛpateḥ sadā ||
mahāśāntirbhavet teṣāṃ durbhikṣaṃ naśyate sadā | mahābhayeṣu sarveṣu ulkābhūkaṃpa pātane ||
ati dṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭiḥ sūciteṣu bhayeṣu ca | akālotpanna puṣpādīṃ daivai naṣṭaiśca khaṃḍitaiḥ ||
jvaralūtādi doṣaiśca apamṛtyubhireva ca | duḥkhairnānāvidhaiścaiva āghrātaṃ maṃḍalaṃ yadi ||
karmadoṣāśca yatkiṃci grahadoṣāśca dāruṇāḥ |
<68a>
tirobhāvaṃ tu cotpannaṃ maṃtracchidraṃ tathāgataṃ | vaṭādi viśanāśena kīṭādi sphoṭakādayaḥ ||
vātapittavikāreṣu śleṣmadoṣeṣu sarvataḥ | arṣāśca cakṣuroṣāśca śaravaisarpakādayaḥ ||
vātajā pittajā doṣā dhātudoṣāstathaiva ca | vyādhyaṃtarāśca ye cānye kṣatajātaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||
abhyaṃtarastho vyādhyaśca śokādyāścintanāśakāḥ | abhiśaptāśca ye kecidbrāhmaṇādyeṣu sarvasu ||
tadānupūrvavadyāgaṃ kartavyaṃ śānti hetutaḥ | pratyahaṃ havanaṃ kāryaṃ rājñorāṣṭravivṛddhaye ||
sukhena bhuṃjate rājyaṃ nātrakāryāvicāraṇā | sakṛt pūjitamātreṇa naśyante vighnakāriṇaḥ ||
naṣṭādaśadiśo yānti siṃhasyaiva yathāmṛgāḥ | satatābhyāsayogena dāridryaṃ naśyate kulān ||
yasmin rāṣṭre ca deśe ca vasate maṃtravit sadā | ītayo vyādhayastatra khārkhodāstaskarā grahāḥ ||
śākinyo vividhā yakṣāḥ piśācārākṣasāstathā |
<68b>
bālagrahāśca visphoṭā vyaṃtarā hyaṃtarāśca ye | sarpā viśānye dośaśca durbhikṣaṃ ripu pīḍinaṃ ||
sarvena prabhavaṃtyatra maṃtravidyatra saṃsthitaḥ | sa pūjyaḥ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ bhūpatīnāṃ ca sarvadā ||
dānapūjādi sammānairasamaiḥ pūjyate yadi | tena pūjitamātreṇa sarve maṃtrāstu pūjitāḥ ||
bhavanti sukhadāstatra tanmukhasthāḥ prapūjitāḥ | sarvatrā cchedakartāra grahāhiṃsanti sādhakaṃ ||
tasmāt grahāṇāṃ dātavyaṃ sarvadevodakodanaṃ | yaṣṭvā bhūtāni tṛpyante tṛptā na bhavanti te ||
tadā rakṣā prakartavyā daiśikena mahātmanā ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāte [rājarakṣādhikāro nāma viṃśatimaḥ paṭalaḥ] || śrīdevyuvāca ||
rakṣā tu kathitā deva prāṇināmanukampayā | kīdṛśī procyate sā tu kasya vā kṛyate kathaṃ ||
vyāpakaḥ puruṣaḥ prokto hyamūrtaḥ sarvadehināṃ |
<69a>
dehī bāhyāntarasthosau nirguṇo hyaśarīra kṛt | kathaṃ tu kṛyate tasya rakṣā kasmā ca rakṣate ||
śarīraṃ sakalaṃ vātha rakṣitavyaṃ kathaṃ ca tan | pṛthivyādi mahābhūtaiḥ nirmitaṃ coditaṃ kila ||
anya tṛtīyo vā rakṣaḥ kasya daivaṃ kathaṃ vibho | kasmācca rakṣaṇiyosau kena vā vada śūladhṛt ||
etat sarvamaśeṣeṇa kā rakṣā bhagavanvada |
bhagavānuvāca ||
śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ na pṛṣṭohaṃ surāsuraiḥ | garuḍādyaistathā śiṣyai bahubhirmunibhirna ca ||
tadadyante pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāyata locane | vyāpakaḥ puruṣaḥ sūkṣmo nirguṇo niṣkṛyo balaḥ ||
kiṃ tvāṇavastathā karmo māyāyastrividho malaḥ | tatsaṃbaṃdhāt samalino hyasvataṃtro hyaśaktimān ||
aśuddhaḥ procyate tasmāt malatraya virodhataḥ | nirmalo vā kathaṃ prokto bhogeṣu savirudhyate ||
<69b>
śuddho bhogī na siddhyeta vikalpo bhoga ucyate | vikalpaḥ sa tu saṃsāraḥ paśoḥ saṃsaraṇaṃ sadā ||
saṃsāryasya tu vaddhasya nirmalatvaṃ yujyate | āṇavaṃ yanmalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kāryato hyupalabhyate ||
abhilāṣaṃ tu tatkāryaṃ bhogādīnāṃ pravartakaṃ | karmayatkaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ deśakālaśarīrataḥ ||
ka (*?) di yatpṛthivyāntaṃ māyā kāryā vidurbudhāḥ | evaṃ malatrayopetaṃ saṃsārī saṃsaraṃtyaṇu ||
kośakārakṛmiryadvadātmānaṃ veṣṭaye dṛḍhaṃ | udveṣṭanena śaktasso(?) tāthātmā pāśapaṃjare ||
yāvanna ceśvaro devo hyanugṛhyāti śaktimān | tāvat malāvagūhena guṃṭhitastiṣṭhate paśuḥ ||
yadi cenneśvaraḥ kaścit svataṃtramakhilaṃ jagat | niyamaḥ kāraṇānāṃ tu na bhavedasamaṃjasaṃ ||
balībaṃdaṃ yadā kaścit baṃdhanaṃ pāśavaṃ dhanaḥ | tṛṇauḥ saṃyojitairbhogairhyasvataṃtrastathā paśuḥ ||
<70a>
hyasya pāśahastasya grāhakaḥ kaścidunnataḥ | samartho dṛśyate yadvattadvadīśopyanugrahī ||
sarveṣāṃ ca sakṛcchaktā svaśaktyābṛṃhitaḥ śivaḥ | aviyuktā (*?) sā tasya nijāraśmī raveriva ||
dāhaprakāśikā vahne ūṣmā naiva viyujyate | tadvadīśasya sā śaktiraviyuktā śivātmikā ||
jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ devi sā caikā bahudhā sthitā | icchājñānakṛyārūpā kṛtya bhedena vartate ||
aghorā sā tadicchāsyād vyāpikā sā mudāyinī | ghorājñāna svarūpā tu sā parigraha vartinī ||
ghorāghoraratā cānyā kṣobhikāyā kṛyātmikā | sā rakṣā sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvarakṣāsurakṣiṇī ||
sā ca dīkṣā samuddiṣṭā dāna (*) paṇalakṣaṇā | anenaiva prakāreṇa sarvadoṣanivarhaṇī ||
vyāpakasya sato puṃsaḥ sā rakṣā na vidhīyate | punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi rakṣāsarvasurakṣiṇī ||
<70b>
(*?) latrayavirodhena nānākarmaphalodayā | śabdādīnāṃ tu viṣaye iṃdṛyāṇāṃ pravartate ||
hṛtpuṃḍarīka madhyasthaṃ dharmādharmapravartakaṃ | rāgadveṣabhibhūtaṃ ca tṛdhāntaḥ karaṇāvṛtaṃ ||
kāryakāraṇasaṃbaṃdhaṃ karaṇairbhūtaṃraṃprataiḥ | nibaddhaṃ cinmale naiva śataśotasahasraśaḥ ||
kāryakāryānta (**?) tai dharmādharmavicintitaiḥ | tijavra(?)lupta caitanyaṃ jīva ityabhidhīyate ||
tasya raktā samuddiṣṭā maṃtrairvividhavistaraiḥ | dhāraṇāmaṃtrataṃtraiśca śivena paramātmanā ||
jīvarakṣā tu sā proktā kriyāśaktirmaheśvara | anyā tṛtīyā rakṣā tu śarīrasya tu rakṣaṇī ||
mahābhayebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtayakṣagrahādikaiḥ | ḍāvyo ḍāmarikābhiśca bhaginyo (*) mārastathā ||
śākinyo yoginībhiśca mukhamaṃḍakādibhiḥ | nānāvidhairaśeṣaiśca hiṃsa (*?) kṛyate dhruvaṃ ||
<71a>
yadbhayaṃ tasya śamanaṃ sā rakṣā śaktirucyate | bhūtajaṃ malinaṃ dehaṃ adhruvaṃ ca aśāśvataṃ ||
vātapittaistathā śleṣmaiḥ sannipātādi (**?) raiḥ | anekaśatasaṃkhyātairdoṣairduṣṭāṃśarīrakaṃ ||
tasya hiṃsanti vahavo hiṃsakā duṣṭabuddhayaḥ | vātapittarujābhūtāśleṣmajāssannipātikaṃ ||
bhoktukāmāvalikāmāratikāmāstathā pare | haṃtu kāmāśca vahā vā hiṃsakāḥ sarvajaṃtuṣu ||
vāta sthānaṃ samāśṛtya vātajāḥ pra (*?) vanti hi | kṣobhayanti svakaṃ sthānaṃ pittajāḥ pittikantataḥ ||
śleṣmajāśca svakaṃ bhāvaṃ sthānaṃ sānnipātajāḥ | kṣobhayaṃti vināśārthaṃ deharakṣā ta (*?) taḥ ||
maṃtrauṣadhi kriyāyoge rakṣā vai śivacoditā | kartavyā śivadā nityā sā śivāśivahāriṇī ||
balikāmānubalibhirghasmaraista (*?) yet pṛye |
<71b>
bhoktukāmāṃjighāṃsanti naśyante maṃtrayogataḥ | ratikāmā anekaiśca maṃtraistaṃtraistathauṣadhaiḥ ||
proktopyanugrahastena maṃtre (*?) maṃtrayoginā | haṃtu kāmāstu ye proktā durādharṣā mahābalāṃ ||
tathāpi pārameśena maṃtratejo balena ca | śivaśaktyā prabhāvena naśyante (*?) trasaṃśayaḥ ||
evaṃ sekṣepataḥ prokto idaṃ bhūtavinirṇayaṃ | prāṇināṃ tu hitārthāya viṣṭarotyatradarśitaḥ ||
evaṃ hi kriyate rakṣā sujñāta (*?) kṛtā bhavet | anyathā svātmaghātāya vartatepyanuyoginaḥ ||
rakṣā bahuprakārāśca kartavyāmnāya darśanāt | ādhārarakṣā pratha (*?) jīvarakṣā dvitīyakā ||
tṛtīyāgarbharakṣā tu sūtikāle caturthikā | paṃcamī bhūtikā rakṣāsnātvā ṣaṣṭhī tu kārayet ||
bālānāṃ saptamī proktā puruṣā(?)ṇāṃ tathāṣṭamī |
<72a>
bhedaṃ tāsāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathādhārādhikārayet | mātāpitroṃparārakṣā kāryā tatva vicintakaiḥ ||
doṣāṃ kṛtvā supuruṣe saṃbhavantyasya hiṃsa(?)kāḥ | hiṃsanti rakṣaṇī yosau saṃbhavārthaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
yadā strī mudritā bhūtaiḥstadā garbho na gṛhyate | eṣā tu prathamā rakṣā ādhārākhyā prakīrtitā ||
(**?) raktamayaḥ kāyaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ yataḥ | tadā tu rakṣitau dvau tu kartavyo maṃtravādibhiḥ ||
ratikāmagrahāye ca kāmācārā hyanekaśaḥ | pibante reta(?*?) ktaṃ ca naktaṃ saṃbhavate kathaṃ ||
tasmāt tu kāraṇādreto rakṣitau saṃbhavo bhavet | saṃbhūtaṃ garbhakaṃ netraṃ saṃrakṣyaṃ garbhapātanaṃ ||
prasūti kāle nārīṇāṃ rakṣāga (*?) viśāradaiḥ | kāryārakṣā prayatnena na ca hiṃsanti hiṃsakāḥ ||
yāvanna sūtikā śuddhā tadgṛhasthaṃ tu bālakaṃ | sūtikā grahadoṣādyā bādhante rakṣayā (**?) ||
<72b>
tasmāt surakṣitau kāryau hyastrādyaistu vicakṣaṇaḥ | sūtikāṃ snānakāle tu bālaṃ vāyaca tatsthitaṃ ||
hiṃsanti balino bhūtā tasmāt snānaṃ tu kāra (*?) | snātvā taduttaraṃ kālaṃ bālarakṣāsamātrikā ||
dhātrī tu kāraṇaṃ tasya kṣīrasparśādi poṣaṇaiḥ | tasmāccairakṣitavyādau dhātrī bālastordhvataḥ ||
sarvakā (*?) carakṣya maṃtrauṣadhi prayogataḥ | dhāraṇādhyānamudrābhimaṃtrairdhūpairatatritaḥ ||
tilājyādi kṛtairhomaiḥ kalaśairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ | śirasi hyabhi (**?) ta rakṣaṇīyaṃ tu sarvadā ||
bālaprabuddhasuptau tu rudamānaṃ prahāsitaṃ | bhuṃjānaṃ śayanasthaṃ tu tiṣṭhantaṃ krīḍanaṃ tathā ||
prabhāte cārddharātre ca madhyāhne sā (**?) care | saṃdhyākāleṣu sarveṣu rakṣaye tantu bālakaṃ ||
devāsurāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ mātrīṇāṃ bhaginīṣu ca | iṣṭagrahapiśācānāṃ saṃdhyākāle tu saṃgamaṃ ||
<73a>
saṃdhyāsu sarvāsu rakṣitavyaṃ tu bālakaṃ | gacchaṃstiṣṭhatsvapaṃ jāgrat sarvakālaṃ tu rakṣayet ||
gacchantaṃ darśanād devi jighāṃsanti jighāṃsakāḥ | rakṣāhīnaṃ tu tiṣṭhan (**?) yatte subhīṣaṇāḥ ||
svasthaṃ kalena suptaṃ tu trāsayanti samantataḥ | jāgrataḥ kevalaṃ rātrau trāsayanti grahādhamāḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena rakṣayet sarvadā śiśuṃ | (**?) nānyairupāyaiśca maṃtravādairvinā pṛye ||
viśeṣādrājatanayaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ hi daiśikaiḥ | bhāgya suk sru praśastaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇarakṣitaṃ ||
dṛṣṭvā yatnena du (**?) jighāṃsanti śiśuṃ śubhaṃ | tasmāt sarvaprakāreṇa dhāraṇābhiranaṃtaraṃ ||
prākārāstrena vā devi maṃtrairvā vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ | likhitairyaṃtra yogairvā pū (**? ḥ) suprayatnataḥ ||
veṣṭitaiḥ kaṃṭhalagnairvā sūtrakaiśca sitādikaiḥ | dhūpairvividharūpaiśca dhāribhirmaṇibhistathā ||
rakṣoghnaistilakairvāpi nīrāṃja (**?) raḥ saraiḥ |
<73b>
rakṣaṇīyā sadā bālā rājaputrāviśeṣataḥ | rājāno rājamāt paṃca sajapantyastathā pṛye ||
anenaiva vidhānena rakṣitavyāṃ suniścitaiḥ | yasma kṣudrā mahābhūtā mātaro duṣṭa cintakāḥ ||
jighāṃsanti prayatnena nityakālamataṃdritāḥ | teṣāṃ praśamanārthāya prāṇināmanukaṃpayā ||
maṃtrāstauṣadhaṃ yatrā (**?) hābalaparākramāḥ | anugrahārthaṃ martyānāṃ mayāsarvevatāritāḥ ||
teṣāmeva hi sarveṣāṃ maṃtrāṇāṃ bhūritejasā | balamojastathā jñānaṃ smṛtirmedhā va (**?) yaḥ ||
jīvanaṃ prabhu sarveṣāṃ mṛtyujit kathitaṃ mayā | bhūriryāgairjapairhomai tapasā saṃyameva ca ||
maṃtrāścāstrāṇi siddhyanti yugadharmānurūpataḥ | tathā (*?) li yuge duṣṭe pāpiṣṭhā yena rādhamāḥ ||
teṣāṃ te siddhidā maṃtrā bhavanti na bhavanti vā | asya devāti devasya kṛtādi yugasaṃsthiti ||
bhāvānurūpa ni (*) nāṃ tapo na vrata sevanāt |
<74a>
sarvabhāvaprasannānāṃ dvaitādvaitajigīṣanā | daurbhāgyālasya yuktānāṃ pāpopahata cetasāṃ ||
bhaktimātrābalaṃ bandhā (**?) te nātrasaṃśaya | cintāratnaṃ yathāsarvaṃ cintitārthaṃ prayacchati ||
tathā sarvaṃ tu netraṃ vai bhāvitasya karoti hi | sūryacaṃdrau yathāloke sāmānyenāva (**?) kau ||
pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca | sāmānyaṃ vartayaṃtyete hyannaṃtkṛddoṣa(?) hṛdyayā ||
tathā sarveṣu bhūteṣu vyāpakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | (***?) prapaṃcarahitaḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvadaḥ prabhuḥ ||
mṛtyujitparamo deva sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ | bhaktimātrāvalaṃvindhā(?)ddhyānadhāraṇa tatparaḥ ||
yosyavettāprapannaśca (**?) niṣkaṃpa cetasaḥ | sasarvaṃ phalamāpnoti sarvasiddhyāruho bhavet ||
iti sarvasrotasaṃgrahasāre mṛtyujidamṛtīśavidhāne [iṣṭapātādyadhikāra (**?) viṃśatimaḥ paṭalaḥ] || śrīdevyuvāca ||
uktaṃ devena me sarvaṃ yanmayāparipṛcchitaṃ | adhunā śrotumicchāmi saṃśayaṃ me hṛdisthitaṃ ||
yoginye (**?) rāścaiva śākinyo balagarvitāḥ | kathaṃ parapure prāṇāḥ kṣaṇādākarṣayanti tāḥ ||
kasmācca nirghṛṇā raudrā tāsāṃ vā kiṃ prayojanaṃ | etat sarva (**?) ṣeṇa bhagavanvaktu marhasi ||
bhagavānuvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutaṃ | yathā prāṇāṃjighāṃsanti paśūnāṃ patiśāsanāt ||
rāgadveṣa (**?) rmuktālobhamohavivarjitāḥ | yāgārthaṃ devadevasya paśavaḥ prokṣayanti tāḥ ||
na lobhena ca hiṃsaṃti na caiva hi jighāṃsayā | mahābhairava devasya śāsa (**?) layantitāḥ ||
yadartha paśavaspṛṣṭvā svayameva svayaṃbhunā | paśavaḥ patiyāgārthamupayujanti nānyathā ||
teṣāmanugrahārthāya paśūnāṃ ca varānane | moca (**?) hi pāpebhyaḥ pāśaughāṃ chedayaṃti tāḥ ||
<75a>
paśūnāmupayuktānāṃ nityamūrddhamatirbhavet | trividhena tu yogena yojayanti śivājñayā ||
pare naiva hi sūkṣmeṇa sva (**?) tritayena tu | yojayaṃti na caivātra ghātayanti balena tāḥ ||
paraḥ sarvātmake tatve niṣkṛyo nirmalastu yaḥ | vyāpakaḥ parameśasya sarvaṃ kāraṇakāraṇaṃ ||
(**?) tāntarālasthaṃ sarvānugrahakārakaṃ | tasminneva niyuktāstā nirmalā vigataklamāḥ ||
ekībhāvamanuprāptā na viyuktāḥ kathaṃcana | tacchaktau tu vilīnā (**?) cchā rūpeṇasaṃsthitāḥ ||
jñātotkarṣāḥ kriyāvasthā yāgayogyāvadhūtikāḥ | tadbhāvaṃ tu samāsthāya tadrūpā yojayanti yat ||
te muktāḥ śivabhūtāstu (**?) ktyā śive ratāḥ | nirmalā śivabhūtāstu tatprabhāvā bhavanti te ||
yathā yogena dīkṣāyāṃ śivatvamupalabhyate | tathā vai yogayogena śivatvamupayā (**?) ||
<75b>
atyantamalinasyāsya prāguktasyādhikāriṇaḥ | malapradhvastarūpasya nirmalatva bhajaṃtitāḥ ||
mūlacchedena hi paśojighāṃsati malatrayaṃ | malaya (****?) sya śarīraṃ na prarohati ||
dīkṣaiva yojane tasya paśornaiva hi ghātanaṃ | vyāpakena svarūpeṇa svaśakti vibhavena ca ||
troṭayanti pāśoḥ pāśāṃ śarī (***?) naṣṭyati | śarīreṇa pranaṣṭena mokṣaṇaṃ na jighāṃsanaṃ ||
dṛḍhapāśaprarūḍhasya baddhasya puruṣasya vā | viyogastu śarīreṇa māraṇantaṃ bidurbudhā ||
(**?) paraprakārastu sūkṣmaṃ caivādhunocyate | sūkṣmaśaktimayaṃ jñānaṃ jñānaśaktyā tu śasyate ||
arāvārāvarāviṣṭyādhvanibhāsāvasānagaṃ | siddhā (**?) ddhidaṃ jñānaṃ khecaryopāsayanti tāḥ ||
ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ paśūnāṃ samalasthitaṃ | nirmalena tu tā devyo jñānenābhi bhavanti hi ||
yathāprasuptaṃ buddha (**?) ḍate tu yatastataḥ |
<76a>
madirāsevamānena yathaivonmāditaḥ kvacit | krīḍate hyasvataṃtratvādvālo vā bhrāmyate kvacit ||
unmatto vā pramattena preryate pa (***?) thā | mātṛbhirguhyakaiḥ śaktyā svena yogabalena tu ||
jīvamākṛśyate kṣipraṃ paśūnāṃ yogavīryataḥ | yattatparamamavyaktaṃ śāśvataṃ hyacalaṃ dhruvaṃ ||
taṃ (****?) yogamārgeṇa praviśya paradehataḥ | parobhūtvā svaśaktyā tu jīvaṃ jīvena veṣṭayet ||
ākramya taṃ hṛdisthānodadhvorddhena praveśataḥ | eka (***?) tvamāpādya samatvaṃ tatra cābhyaset ||
paraṃ kāraṇamāśṛtya svataṃtratvaṃ samabhyaset | vyāpakena svarūpeṇa śaktyāśaktiṃ tu ānayet ||
tadā tatsaṃpuṭa (***?) śānticchedaṃ tu kārayet | śaktirūpaṃ tato devi tatvamāsthāpayogavit ||
svatatvasattārūpeṇa citsūryatvena tāpayet | drāvayet tatparastho (***?) raśmiṣu cārkavat ||
<76b>
yojayeddhṛdaye sarvān śabdādīnāṃdriyāṇi ca | bhūtāni rasabhūtāni guṇānyeva hi sarvaśaḥ ||
ataḥ karaṇasaṃghātaṃ gṛhītvā (**?) cetasā | praviśetta tadā yogī puramākramyasarvaśaḥ ||
drutaṃ gṛhītvā tatsarvaṃ kṣipramātmasthamānayet | tatkṣaṇādānaye jīvaṃ mudrāmaṃtraprayo (**?) ||
anena vidhinā sūkṣmaṃ yogaṃ yogī samabhyaset | tatsarvaṃ prāpnuyāt kṣipraṃ sūkṣmaṃ yogena yogavit ||
sūkṣmayogaḥ samākhyātaḥ sthūlaścai (**?) cyate | piṃḍasthanprayogena piṃḍamākarṣaye dhruvaṃ ||
maṃtramudrāvidhānena vidhināpāśameva ca | dhyānayogabalenaiva cchummakādyaṃgalakṣaṇai(?) ||
(**?) yaṃtitasaṃdehaḥ paśūnāṃ pāśavaṃ puraṃ | trividhena tu yogena yogino balagarvitāḥ ||
jighāsaṃti yadā devi tadāśreyaḥ samācaret | mṛtyu (***?) maṃ devamanṛtaṃ sarvatomukhaṃ ||
<77a>
pareṇaiva svarūpeṇa vyāpakatvena maṃtravit | jñātvā tatparamaṃ yogaṃ maṃtrī vyāpyapaśoḥ puraṃ ||
icchāśaktyātvadhiṣṭhā(?****?) jīvitaṃ śubhaṃ | saṃrakṣodyogavinmaṃtrī kramaṃ jñātvā tu yogināṃ ||
pūrvoktānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ hiṃsakānāṃ yaśasvini | sūkṣmaṃ svaśaktimārgeṇa cakra(?**?) ma yogataḥ ||
